## Exclusive: Walz Abandoned His Troops
**Tuesday, October 25th, 2022** Friend, Tim Walz' failures as Governor were predictable, according to Command Sergeant Major (Retired) Thomas Behrends. In 2005, Walz abruptly abandoned his troops and exited the MN Army National Guard before deploying as the second highest ranking enlisted member of the unit. Behrends was then tasked to take over the position Walz left vacant. I sat down with Behrends in 2018 to discuss this. Who would've known the leadership challenges that awaited Tim Walz in the next four years. And no surprise - WALZ FAILED TO LEAD! **Today, I had an opportunity to sit back down with CSM (R) Behrends and discuss Tim Walz' abandonment of the troops and how this relates to his current failures as Commander-in-Chief of Minnesota. Both Behrends and I are Iraq War veterans with a unique perspective. [1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Hi Derek,

Our final public fundraising reporting deadline is just 5 hours away, and
we’re still counting on a surge of donations to hit our $1 million goal by
then:

[ Animated ]A GIF of a progress bar of Stacey Abrams' campaign $1,000,000
fundraising goal. It fills up to 85% completion.

Derek. But if just 20% of the
people reading this email donate right now, we’ll hit our goal in no time.
Can you make your
first donation of just
$5 before midnight to maintain our historic voter turnout
and elect Stacey Abrams as the next Governor of Georgia?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/5405?refcode=Sa_em_221025_B5_ProgressBar_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=15131%2E1862389%2Eath_TB ]DONATE

Stacey is known worldwide as a leading voice in the voting rights movement
and the fight for a better Georgia. But Brian Kemp is trying to turn
Stacey’s leadership against us, denying what she really is: a champion for
the freedom to vote.

We need a surge of donations to change the narrative and continue to
mobilize voters in the last two weeks of Early Vote. We simply cannot
allow Brian Kemp’s attack ads to drown us out. We need to make sure we can
relay Stacey’s vision, policies and character.

And doing all that takes substantial resources — we still have volunteers
to recruit, ads to fund, voters to empower and more.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/5405?refcode=Sa_em_221025_B5_ProgressBar_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=15131%2E1862389%2Eath_TB ]That’s why our winning strategy relies on meeting tonight’s goal. Our
fundraising numbers will be locked in a couple of hours and could make or
break our momentum leading into this election. So, we can’t risk falling
short. Make a donation of $5 right now to help us reach as
many Georgians as possible and help us win.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/5405?refcode=Sa_em_221025_B5_ProgressBar_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=15131%2E1862389%2Eath_TB ]DONATE

I’m proud to say I think I did just that. Winning this debate is an important step for my campaign, but we can’t get complacent because this race is going to be extremely close. The poll workers that staff Lake County Elections are required by law to be a mix of Republicans and Democrats ...unless one party
cannot provide a sufficient number of poll workers. In that case, there won’t be Republican eyes in the room. It is important to
be certain we have Republicans at every polling location to help process the election and to watch for and report any shenanigans.

We still need 60 Republicans to serve as poll workers in precincts throughout Lake County – particularly in heavily Democrat
areas.

If we don’t have a Republican worker in each polling location, the rules could go out the window and the door is open to election
shenanigans.

...we'd have no way of knowing if the rules are being followed.

To help ensure the results are fair for Jennifer-Ruth, we need your help! [http://email.email.jennifer-ruth.com/c/eJxFTztvgzAY_DV4KzJ-wuAhQ9JQVZXaqI3UJfLjM7g14AIp4t-XZKl0w0mne9lLcOpw3NXrtP8-nfjrS9K0r-MZxcHeNHi2x09f_5ClObN1XErz_oGg0yFe5jWBsrpLOjQ9CopgQgpMBMak4CLXuqokpboqvNGei4zhuy__gr4PHsaH8Tq3uR061CpcMSeplVpA5QUhwKWn2BBuCu2w9Siqdp7TlNFdRg4bnt4e82ZIG_sd4rWfAUY0KpeWEGOYhNzamnvbLf9_7-2SoLxkxgCmXjrQDKzwruQEgSqEEJJRWUjkVIkNJu4PbQhb0w]

What do poll workers do?

Poll workers process the voters, on a precinct level, on Election Day. There are three main roles: (1) Inspector, (2) Judge, and
(3) Clerk.

Inspector - Picks up election supplies, oversees the precinct, administers the oath, returns supplies.

Judge - Assists the inspector in making decisions, sets up and provides instructions to all voters on how to use the voting
machines.

Clerk - Asks voters to provide photo ID and processes voters on the PollPad

Who can be a poll worker?

Poll workers are nominated by the county chairpersons of the two major political parties. Poll workers must be voters of the
county. Students, 16 or 17 years of age, may serve as poll workers with a completed student form and permission signatures. Please
refer to the Election Day handbook for further qualifications.

Can I leave the poll location on Election Day?

No. Poll Workers must remain in the polling location for the day. Please make arrangements for your meals and whatever you may
need for the entire day.

How much do poll workers get paid and when do I get paid?

• Judges $175 (Additional $25 if the Republican judge returns the equipment with the Inspector)

• Clerks $175

Poll worker paychecks are processed by the Auditor's office and are generally delivered via USPS six weeks after the election.

Poll workers are the front line defenders of the electoral process on Election Day. This is one of the most important jobs during
the election and quite simply, we cannot ensure a fair election without sufficient numbers of Republican election workers.

| | Dear Friend,

**Two of the most important elections in America are in Alaska on Nov. 8: Congresswoman Peltola and Senator Murkowski** are key bipartisan voices that make sure Congress gets things done.

As a nonpartisan voice committed to bipartisanship and building back better through infrastructure, **[Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=f996a4ad69&e=110fec2088) is endorsing both candidates.

[Will you join us in fighting to re-elect Congresswoman Peltola and Senator Murkowski by making a donation of $25 to the Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund?](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=83b518ecfc&e=110fec2088)**

Both are running extremely tight re-election campaigns, and **they are the only candidates in their respective races who are _pro-choice_ and _pro-infrastructure_**. We support these campaigns because they have proven through their votes that they will prioritize Alaskans’ and Americans’ best interests, not their own or their party’s.
---
| [SUPPORT INFRASTRUCTURE & CHOICE »](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=d7c4976d1b&e=110fec2088 "SUPPORT INFRASTRUCTURE & CHOICE »")
---
| **While Senator Murkowski and Representative Peltola are working with congressional colleagues from both sides of the aisle to build a more sustainable future, Sarah Palin, Kelly Tshibaka, and Nick Begich III are busy fighting** _against_**federal infrastructure funding and** _against_**Americans’ right to choose.**

Friend, all Americans deserve a congressional delegation that fights for what’s best, and I hope you will help make that happen with a donation to Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund.

**[Will you chip in to Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund today so we can help elect the leaders who will fight for infrastructure and choice?](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=7a1310022f&e=110fec2088)**

| Thank you,

Fran Ulmer
Former Lieutenant Governor of Alaska
_Frances “Fran” Ulmer is the outgoing chair of[The Nature Conservancy’s Global Board of Directors](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=622b36b9a3&e=110fec2088), a senior fellow at [Harvard’s Belfer Center](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=4398a2db36&e=110fec2088) and has been a visiting professor both at Stanford and at Harvard’s Institute of Politics. She has served Alaska and northern interests for decades as Alaska’s Lieutenant Governor, state legislator, Mayor of Juneau, Alaska, professor, lawyer, research director, special advisor to the State Department on the Arctic, and Chair of the [U.S. Arctic Research Commission](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=bf92985721&e=110fec2088)._

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

My dad immigrated to the U.S. from Mexico in 1950. He believed in the power of hard work to make a difference. He worked in the fields, served two tours in Vietnam, and took a union job to provide a path into the middle class for our family.
While we didn’t have a lot growing up, my family believed that through hard work, you can achieve anything. It took me seven years to graduate college – and I juggled multiple jobs, from painting houses to pouring coffee – but I put in the hard work and earned that degree.
My daughter was born 17 years ago, and my family’s hard work gave me the determination that I needed to leave the world a better place for her. That’s why I stepped up to join the Oregon legislature.
As a legislator, I’ve fought for more affordable health care, helped Oregon begin to tackle our climate crisis, and passed the nation’s most progressive paid family leave bill. It takes hard work to get these things done, but I was determined.
With that same level of determination, I’m running for Congress. I’m ready to fight for families just like mine in Congress, but I need your help.

clean_body: = Friend, I’m running for Congress in one of the most competitive seats in the entire country. This race is neck-and-neck, and we are running out of time to make an impact. = | = My dad immigrated to the U.S. from Mexico in 1950. He believed in the power of hard work to make a difference. He worked in the fields, served two tours in Vietnam, and took a union job to provide a path into the middle class for our family. While we didn’t have a lot growing up, my family believed that through hard work, you can achieve anything. It took me seven years to graduate college – and I juggled multiple jobs, from painting houses to pouring coffee – but I put in the hard work and earned that degree. My daughter was born 17 years ago, and my family’s hard work gave me the determination that I needed to leave the world a better place for her. That’s why I stepped up to join the Oregon legislature. As a legislator, I’ve fought for more affordable health care, helped Oregon begin to tackle our climate crisis, and passed the nation’s most progressive paid family leave bill. The only thing I’m guilty of is making my opponent and national Democrats spend money to defend a congressional seat they think belongs to them | [](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=04ae077908af4d2b93c45fe2720222b8&_e=X1VXrBa9GYrKPzs8kT_BN2iKL2GUG67HYSn8NWCuC-DaPz3OHHMwZcJbDcou7HfD9yeIVk204fTlAv-BhBqAkJJW_56vr2P2fEPdYW_715ANSkMDvwFX9OlyhufW5kSEkvOsloEFs53pG10ZXpAjv7DXp9nIXljSf-P9X-SDRZUbXzutGunqTSf7kaDzlt0WS3_ehHB5DelpOfzYyC20vlNrWJFdyiIl0QIX0ZUQZDpgaivACbgStmwI1MUwvcr3k7NPUYyKOplf7PxIdSvidEcOoq62mqgqdCBgIAfsh2M_8AqSl8fIR-ROqYm__cg8e3Zcoozn_cgzIxOMfWSNrfJPPjsEQnm2i-YDrjgCOndqXs-_yb777RlgxCjMfmHW)

Peter,

Yesterday was not a good fundraising day, and that is putting it lightly. **If I’m being totally honest, it was the worst day of the month so far.**

**Just 22 people donated to the email that I sent out yesterday for a total of $370.** If you read the note yesterday morning, then you may recall that needed that email to raise $10,038– more than**_27 times what we wound up raising by the day’s end._**

I don’t want to sound like an alarmist, but yesterday’s fundraising totals shocked me to the core. Fellow American,

When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days.

I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, _Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder_ , with the goal of helping others.

This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles.

**But their ads didn't work.** The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race.

In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion.

**Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie.**

We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth.

**[Fellow American, today I need your assistance more than ever before in this campaign. Unfortunately, that's politics these days. I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder , with the goal of helping others. This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles. But their ads didn't work. The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race. In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion. Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie. We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth. Undecided voters are watching this race closely, and the Left knows it. That's why, 35 days before the election, they decided to distract from the real issues by telling a lie about me. First, the Left used these tactics against Justice Clarence Thomas in an unsuccessful effort to keep him off the Supreme Court. Then, 27 years later, they did the same thing to Justice Brett Kavanaugh as they tried to destroy him, his reputation, and his family. Their intimidation tactics didn't work on Justices Thomas or Kavanaugh, and they're not going to work on me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more. | | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson:Hello,Racial tensions have certainly been on the rise in recent years. And unfortunately, it has led to a growing divide in America.

But it doesn’t have to be this way.

Many of the arguments made in support of ideas like Critical Race Theory (CRT) ignore reality. They promote victimhood and perpetuate the divide that has already gripped our nation. We all need to push back against these divisive and harmful beliefs.

To better equip you, we’ve created a new eBook that provides answers to many of the “questions” that those promoting CRT like to use. Please get your copy of _5 Answers to Critical Race Theory.

_ I’m emailing because I really want to make sure that you get your free copy today.[](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.)
__Inside, you’ll learn some of the history and solutions to
* Racial disparities of the wealth gap
* Criminal justice biases
* And housing issues

We also take some time to provide common sense, conservative solutions to many of the issues related to the racial divide in America.

Please be sure to get your free copy of this important eBook right now. I really think you’ll find the information valuable.You can access it using this secure link:[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/5-answers-to-crt/](http://trk.patriotmarketplace._HSLNTNyH49vRQSFZR0K6w)Regards,

body:

subject: I want you to know why I’m running to take back Arizona
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blake Masters for Senate**
body:

I wanted to reach out personally | I know you've heard a lot from my campaign lately, but with only a few weeks left until the Election...

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z327pvutlro6b3d3r0oo8frfjrr1o1ha5ijbau1g_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctjm1ob4slh2bs)

Friend,

Do you have a minute?

I know you've heard a lot from my campaign lately, but with only a few weeks left until the Election, I wanted to take the time to reach out personally.

Let me start by telling you about myself and why I felt compelled to run for Senate: Arizona has helped shape my life for the better \- and I owe this state so much. I grew up here and am proud to still call Arizona home, along with my incredible wife Catherine and our three boys.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2za32fkpsdaer387ko843lrmvf90ieisq6ia6de90_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctjm1ob4slh2bs)

That's why it's so deeply troubling to see what the failed leadership of the Biden administration and my opponent, Mark Kelly, have done to our nation.

Whether it is _**dangerous criminals**_ pouring across our unsecured border, _**crushing inflation**_ that is killing family-owned businesses, or _**teaching toxic ideologies**_ to our children, Democrats are destroying the America we know and love.

This country deserves so much better, **and I 'm running to create a more prosperous future for ALL Americans.**

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zllmmmvc9aduk18k04ght7prhr02eiij7plqo9lo_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctjm1ob4slh2bs)

**[HELP DELIVER A BETTER FUTURE FOR ARIZONA AND AMERICA.>>](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zk4hkj9ahjj7902tsi103ejta95fedut8qkfvihg_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctjm1ob4slh2bs)**

I know what it takes to tackle difficult problems and build success from scratch. I'm an America First outsider who has spent my career in the private sector creating jobs and investing in our youth. I'm committed to bringing YOUR voice to Washington _**and won 't EVER back down from fighting to put America First.**_

Let me be absolutely clear - _I 'm not interested in the political games of Washington._ I'm running for Senate because decent, hard-working people like **YOU** deserve solutions to the problems you face on a daily basis.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zm2nkf3di0pn8alcerqo3n8d6ppedbq7hd05g728_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctjm1ob4slh2bs)

We all know what is at stake on November 8th: The future of our state, our country, and control of the Senate. It is beyond critical that we restore **competent, conservative leadership** in Washington.

My race is extremely close and will be decided in this campaign's final days and weeks. I'm confident that united, we WILL win this election for the America First movement and begin building a better future for our nation. I'd be honored to have your support in this critical fight.

**[PLEASE CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT YOU CAN TO HELP US WIN THIS ELECTION FOR THE AMERICA FIRST MOVEMENT.>>](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zculon5qk61b34kal88qshmooforbj8jbknsk8ag_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctjm1ob4slh2bs)**

Thank you,

Blake Masters
U.S. Senate Candidate from Arizona

**[CONTRIBUTE NOW>>](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z585bqvrea3qm185dq1k80thgcgb1o13cjjn6pog_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctjm1ob4slh2bs)**

name: Pro Life Update
subject: Victor Davis Hanson on DVD
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zjlvgvu11qdaotmafq2n1n6sfusm9dllhtb64pgg_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctjm1ob4sph2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zfef0660c8lr2d0jkuja13gjmv7odkqsegg66b40_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctjm1ob4sph2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z0ctdpsu83g37vug6jv36gdmku03fgb9v89q2bvo_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctjm1ob4sph2bs)** Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

body:
Radical leftist teachers and school districts have gone too far.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z1gdue3cq9ur24c12pbieog76t0imqpc2flal2bg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk4qj4ttkumqn4s9nmorb79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4ongscoeaphke5ibac35c6oncorje4qn6ttkmapm8ptnmarm6cjhe1jmcthhcop61puie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9gmmqj0sjgcpqm5cr66uobapbi46h22sh2s8i66or3ctjm1ob6cph2bs)
| | | Friend,
Radical leftist teachers and school districts have gone too far. First, they tried shoving Critical Race Theory and transgender propaganda down our throats. Then, they began holding secret “equality clubs” and convinced children that they might be bisexual or transgender without telling their parents. Now, they’re doing everything in their power to completely silence and censor anyone who fights back. **In fact, they’re even BANNING parents from attending their own children’s graduation ceremonies if they disagree with the woke curriculum being taught.** I’m happy to announce that we’re taking legal action to fight back, but we need your help urgently. **[Which is why I’m asking for an emergency donation of $35 or more today to help the Center for American Liberty protect free speech and fight back against the venomous cancel culture that has infiltrated our schools.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zhghn421sc8sp1752is458nem1p7fgi0kns7c3i0_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctjm1ob6cph2bs)** Shawn McBreairty is the father of a high school senior in Bangor, Maine who was told that he was not allowed to attend his daughter’s graduation ceremony. Why? Because Shawn had the audacity to question the public school’s curriculum and speak out against radical school board members. You see, Shawn filed a series of public record requests (FOAA) and complaints about the conduct of school personnel.** ****However, instead of investigating the issues that Shawn was pointing out, the school district filed a lawsuit against Shawn, seeking to silence him and prevent him from ever filing FOAA requests ever again.** And on top of that, the school district informed him that he was not allowed to attend any of his daughter’s graduation events. But Shawn hasn’t given up – in fact, he’s now working with my team to take the fight to the next level. We’ve filed an Anti-SLAPP motion to dismiss the ridiculous lawsuit against Shawn—because Shawn’s speech is CLEARLY protected by the First Amendment. We’re fighting hard, but we can’t do it without you. **[Will you join the fight for to protect the rights of parents like Shawn today with a gift of $35 or more?](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zmqiv3l77911ohdv1o0qba3vmpbkq7eg8djp3kp0_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctjm1ob6cph2bs)** Let me take a moment to introduce myself. My name is Harmeet Dhillon. I'm the Founder of the Center for American Liberty and I've dedicated my career to preserving Constitutional liberties like the freedom of speech which are constantly under attack by the radical left. The Constitution clearly protects your ability to criticize public officials and government employees. It doesn’t matter if it’s the President of the United States or a school board member in your community – no one is above criticism. You and I cannot allow school districts like the Herman School Department in Bangor, Maine, to get away with censoring parents. **Enough is enough.** It’s time for all of us to stand with parents like Shawn and let these radical schools know that they will no longer be allowed to silence us or corrupt our kids. There’s no time to waste. [**So please, send your urgent gift of $35 or more today and help us defeat this ridiculous lawsuit with our Anti-SLAPP motion today.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z8uld53grqtrq1d51cjvsvqh06mv4m7vvprf3sh0_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctjm1ob6cph2bs) Thank you in advance for your support. Onward to victory,

Harmeet K. Dhillon

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: The challenges we face at this moment
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-beto?refcode=20221026_Beto_split [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-beto?refcode=20221026_Beto_split]
Friends,
I don't know that there's a more important moment, in a more important place than what's happening in Texas today.
Please split a contribution between Seth Moulton and my campaign right now. It’ll help make sure that we have the resources to reach the voters who are going to decide the outcome of the most important governor's race in America. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-beto?refcode=20221026_Beto_split]
It was 19 months ago when the power grid — which Greg Abbott had been warned about — absolutely failed us. The lights went out, the heat stopped running, and the water stopped flowing because it was frozen in the pipes for millions of Texans. More than 700 people died — of hypothermia, carbon monoxide poisoning in their garages, and burning up in their homes as they set fire to their furniture trying to keep their kids warm.
During this crisis, Abbott pegged the price of electricity at its highest allowable rate for days and gas soon started trading at 200 times what it had sold for before. Abbott's biggest campaign contributors ended up making billions of dollars over the course of those five days. The kicker is that after all that happened, the grid is still not fixed, and we are all paying higher electricity and utility bills as a result.
This governor failed the most basic job of government, to keep the lights on in the energy capital of the world. Add to that that we now lead the nation in the number of school shootings, and that gun violence is now the leading cause of death for kids and teenagers in the state of Texas.
This week marks 22 weeks since 19 kids and their two amazing teachers were killed in their classrooms by an 18-year-old who could legally buy not one but two AR-15s and hundreds of rounds of ammunition. Five of the worst mass shootings in U.S. history have happened in the last five years, and the only thing that Abbott has done is make it easier for people who shouldn't have a weapon to buy a gun and carry them openly on our streets.
What may be most galvanizing for millions in this state is the extreme abortion ban that Abbott signed into law that just went into effect in August. It begins at conception with no exception for rape or incest. This is happening in a state that leads the country in this crisis of maternal mortality that is three times as deadly for Black women. We absolutely know this is going to cause more suffering and death in the state of Texas.
The challenges we face today are the greatest in living memory. But the way that Texans are responding is incredibly inspiring and fills me with optimism and a lot of confidence that we're going to win this fight on November 8th.
People are not accepting this, they're not submitting to it, and they're not succumbing to the temptation to despair. They're taking action and they're showing up.
Will you join our growing effort to win this election, overcome these challenges, and get Texas on the right track by splitting a $20 donation today between Seth Moulton and my campaign? I need you with us. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-beto?refcode=20221026_Beto_split]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-beto?refcode=20221026_Beto_split]Thank you,
Beto

name: Lindsey Graham
subject: Campaign Update
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Team Graham, Inc
body:
Just imagine how much more damage Joe Biden and Chuck Schumer can do if they keep the majority for another two years?! |
---
Fellow American,

I am doing whatever I can to help elect a new Republican majority in the U.S. Senate. I've been campaigning in Georgia, Ohio, Arizona, North Carolina - all over the country to help us win on November 8th.

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60998904:sFr4EqhNv:m:1:877327319:A32A2BD87F3BD13B894096A59F7E438B:r)
On the campaign trail in Georgia with Herschel Walker and in Arizona with Blake Masters
The conventional wisdom holds that Senate races in eight states are the key. Four of these seats are currently held by Republicans - which we need to maintain, and the other four are held by Democrats. A gain of just one seat will give Republicans the majority and stop the Biden agenda dead in its tracks.

While Republicans have momentum because of President Biden's sagging poll numbers, the Radical Left is helping Democrats outraise Republicans by a staggering margin. _**Many of our top candidates are being outraised by a factor of two to one, three to one, or even worse!**_

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60998904:sFr4EqhNv:m:1:877327319:A32A2BD87F3BD13B894096A59F7E438B:r)
In Ohio with JD Vance
**[Fellow American, to help us close the gap and save America from two more years of destructive left-wing policies, will you rush an emergency gift of $10, $22, or even $50 for our RECLAIM THE MAJORITY effort today?](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60998904:sFr4EqhNv:m:1:877327319:A32A2BD87F3BD13B894096A59F7E438B:r)** I am working hand-in-hand with a number of campaigns and the national GOP, and your support will help me help them.

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60998904:sFr4EqhNv:m:1:877327319:A32A2BD87F3BD13B894096A59F7E438B:r)
In North Carolina with Ted Budd
Probably the most frustrating thing about the current problems facing our country is that none of them had to happen. They were all self-inflicted. Inflation, high gas prices, empty store shelves, increased crime, the invasion taking place at our Southern Border... Joe Biden and the Democrats are personally responsible for all of it.

If those problems aren't bad enough, just imagine how much more damage Joe Biden and Chuck Schumer can do if they keep the Senate majority for another two years?!

They want to expand and pack the Supreme Court with liberals because they don't like recent decisions, and they are weaponizing the legal system because they are desperate. They want to abolish the Electoral College so New York and California will pick our president. They want to federalize elections so they can harvest more ballots and end voter ID. And of course, they want to take more of your hard-earned money at a time when they've driven the cost of everything to a 40-year high!

They've promised to do all of this, and more, and it scares me to death. It should scare the dickens out of you, too.

Please, Fellow American - we're less than 2 weeks out from an election that will change the trajectory of our country. **[Help us win back the Senate majority by RUSHING $5 or more in the next 24 hours.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60998904:sFr4EqhNv:m:1:877327319:A32A2BD87F3BD13B894096A59F7E438B:r)**

Thank you,

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60998904:sFr4EqhNv:m:1:877327319:A32A2BD87F3BD13B894096A59F7E438B:r)

Lindsey Graham

P.S. Just eight states will decide if Joe Biden maintains complete control over our country for another two years. I am determined to make sure our great Republican candidates for Senate have the resources they need to win. _**[Will you help, Fellow American?](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60998904:sFr4EqhNv:m:1:877327319:A32A2BD87F3BD13B894096A59F7E438B:r)**_

| [** Donate Today -> **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60998904:sFr4EqhNv:m:1:877327319:A32A2BD87F3BD13B894096A59F7E438B:r)

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60998905:sFr4EqhNv:m:1:877327319:A32A2BD87F3BD13B894096A59F7E438B:r)
In the United States Senate, South Carolina's Lindsey Graham has earned a reputation as a conservative, a problem-solver, and a leader who gets things done. He is a great friend to our men and women serving in uniform, a respected voice on national security matters, a leading advocate for cutting the out-of-control spending in Washington, and a champion for confirming conservative judges.

body:
There's no overtime on this campaign

| |
---
Hi team – As you might know, Eric is a huge Buccaneers, Rays and Lightning fan. Everyone always likes a tight game, but in this campaign, there’s no overtime. **In case you haven’t heard, Eric and Anna Paulina Luna, his extremist GOP opponent, are tied in the race for FL-13, both polling at 47%.** In the new survey, released by David Binder Research, Eric is leading with unaffiliated independent voters, 48% to Luna’s 43%. This is a great sign, but we need to get the word out to more Democrats and unaffiliated voters about how to vote and why it’s so important that we elect Eric as our next representative in Pinellas County. **If you aren’t familiar with Anna Paulina Luna, she’s a right-wing extremist supported by the likes of Donald Trump and Matt Gaetz, and she brought Marjorie Taylor Greene to this district because she wants to emulate her in Congress.** She’s refused to debate Eric for our entire race and recently skipped out on a forum with local community members and businesses – which Eric of course attended and was very well received. She backed out at the last minute from participating in an AARP and Bay News 9 debate. **Essentially, Luna’s gone into hiding to keep her extremist view hidden from voters, especially when they’re compared to Eric’s experience and practical policy platform. She knows it won’t be a pretty comparison.** Even if Anna Paulina Luna refuses to participate in democratic debates or community events, we can tell you what she might say. She would probably leave out her refusal to acknowledge the validity of the 2020 election results. She’d tout her views as a “pro-life” extremist who supports a full abortion ban with no exceptions, not even to save the life of the mother. She’d back her Extremist Republican colleagues at all costs—because those are the extremists backing and advising her campaign. [**Eric has found his support in people like you, team. That’s why he needs your help to make sure he can come away with a win on Election Day. We can’t have a tie, and Eric needs to win this race to protect our Democratic majority in Congress and ensure a positive future for Pinellas County. Peter,

The first time I ran for office I lost my primary, but as a product of the American dream, I don't believe in giving up.

My name is Catalina, and I'm the America First Hispanic woman running for Congress in what is now the **__CLOSEST RACE IN AMERICA__** **-** the one race that will define Nancy Pelosi's legacy.

This is my first time reaching out to you, and I'm afraid of what happens if this email doesn't work.

_**But I'm not afraid to tell you that I am a Christian who is Pro-Life, Pro-Family, and Pro-Law Enforcement.**_

Democrats and their partners in the liberal media will tell you that someone of my ethnicity and my age can't be any of those things. They assume that I'm just a Hispanic millennial who won't challenge them on their lack of principles, platform, and patriotism.

I'm not a career politician with a Rolodex of corporate mega-donors. As a Conservative, I'll admit that I struggle asking others for help, but I know that I have to because this race is about so much more than me.

So I'm asking you to chip in just a few bucks today to help my campaign move forward, united against the radical left and their liberal agenda. **_We're so close to flipping this seat & with your help, I know we will!_**

Catalina Lauf

subject: What I told President Zelenskyy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swalwell For Congress
body:
Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District.
https://ericswalwell.com/ [https://ericswalwell.com/]
Friends,

Last week, I traveled to Ukraine to meet President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and his senior leaders. I was able to get their firsthand account of Russia’s brutal war and observed the destruction in Kyiv myself.

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP43/1/90727/images/image1.jpeg]My trip to Kyiv not only offered the opportunity to witness the steadfast resolve of the Ukrainian people but also the leadership of President Zelenskyy and his team. Their unwavering strength is both inspiring and a beacon of hope for all who are committed to fighting back against oppression.

As a Member of the Congressional Ukraine Caucus and the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence, I reaffirmed to President Zelenskyy our commitment to Ukraine in these difficult times.

I pledged to President Zelenskyy that I would continue to advocate in Congress for resources to keep Ukraine in the fight. Because Ukraine’s fight for freedom is every democracy’s fight.

If they fall, any of us could be next. If Ukraine succeeds, we all renew the promise of democracy. We will not stop until Russian troops are out of Ukraine.

So while there is always so much happening in the news, please, never forget the people of Ukraine and their ongoing fight for freedom, and let’s recommit to standing up for democracy everywhere.

– Eric

Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

I know that’s a big number, I could hardly believe it either. But we’re a grassroots team going up against an opponent with millions in special interest money behind him— so every dollar counts.

| | | Peter, my name is Adam Laxalt. You may have never heard of me, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about why I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

I was born in Reno, Nevada and raised by a single mother. Growing up, it was just me and my mom. I have always aspired to be as much of a leader as she was.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61735882:JOlqBjGLN:m:1:3361486117:114A356645F74919B08B156B40DD3CAE:r "Adam 1")
---

I know that real leadership means standing up for what you believe in and standing up for people everywhere. But I was headed down the wrong path in life.

As a teenager, I suffered from addiction. But the people who loved me got me help. I turned my life around, and that taught me helping others gives life meaning. That's why I volunteered to serve in the Navy after 9/11 and volunteered to serve in the Iraq War.

---
| | | [SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61735882:JOlqBjGLN:m:1:3361486117:114A356645F74919B08B156B40DD3CAE:r "SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT")
---

Serving our country as a Navy Officer in Iraq was an honor.

While I was serving, my unit was in charge of over 20,000 detainees to keep American troops safe. This was one of the most challenging experiences of my life, but also the most rewarding.

_Knowing that I was on the front lines of protecting the country I love so dearly is something that I will continue to cherish for the rest of my life. _

After returning from Iraq, I felt the call to serve my state again and went on to be Nevada's Attorney General and top law enforcement officer. I fought hard to serve the people of Nevada, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

Now I'm taking on a huge challenge for our country: running for U.S. Senate.

subject: Manners & Kindness
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
Above everything else, I made sure that my kids were raised with compassionate hearts and respect for others.
| | |
---
Peter,

"Be kind and have good manners."
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53371348/375226325/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk392-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjczM2Y4Yi0zZjU1LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7MZmkGUp-dDS5-_VKIohkO2lpTtf2onGd8mNY_L6hwo=)
I can't count the number of times I repeated this mantra to my children – before family gatherings, on the first day of school, at the dinner table. **Above everything else, I made sure that my kids were raised with compassionate hearts and respect for others.**
But frankly, I have been thinking about what it will be like in the Senate, and it seems like far too many of the folks running things in Washington lack both kindness and manners. Legislators are pushing their far-right, out-of-touch ideologies instead of actually helping the families who are counting on them. They're picking partisan fights instead of putting their heads down and doing the work. **And if my opponent, Eric Schmitt, gets to Washington, he'll be just another extremist with no manners and no kindness.**
**I promise you, Peter, that I will be different.** As senator, I will treat everyone who comes through my office doors with the manners and compassion that my parents taught me – and which I passed on to my own kids. I will always lead with kindness, respect, and a listening ear.

Our campaign is all about putting Ohio first, folks.

It’s why I’ve spent my campaign traveling to all 88 counties and why I
have continued to criss-cross our state on the Workers First
Express—because this campaign is focused on building real, meaningful
relationships with Ohioans.

I wanted to look as many folks in the eyes as possible, shake their hands,
and let them know I’m someone they can trust—someone who will fight for
their families in the Senate.

But my right-wing opponent JD Vance? That guy doesn’t give a sh*t about
Ohio. He has two big donors—neither of whom are from Ohio—and that’s who
he’ll serve in the Senate.

We don’t need an out-of-touch millionaire representing
Ohio. [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/28908?t=1008&amount=32&akid=6277%2E3611125%2EvY6t2R ]So
can you pitch in $32 to help me defeat JD in the race that will decide
Senate control?

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/28908?t=1009&amount=32&akid=6277%2E3611125%2EvY6t2R ]Donate

It all started with Silicon Valley billionaire Peter Thiel, who poured $15
million into Ohio just to keep JD’s campaign from falling face first in
the GOP primary.

Then came Kentucky’s own Mitch McConnell, who dumped $40 million (and
counting) into Ohio to help JD win the seat he needs to retake Senate
control.

Frankly, it’s disgusting—and it’s exactly the type
of Washington insider politics Ohioans have been trying to avoid for
years.

That’s why I’m so proud of the campaign we’re running. We’ve earned the
support of more than 350,000 grassroots donors and 95% of all donations
are under $100.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/28908?t=1010&amount=25&akid=6277%2E3611125%2EvY6t2R ]We’re going to win this race $10 or $25 at a time—not by relying on a
couple of multi-million $$ handouts from out-of-state donors. So, if
you’re with us, will you chip in your $10 or $25 donation today so we can
defeat JD and flip Ohio blue?

subject: Have you seen what they're doing to our kids?

We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help t
| | | Dear Fellow Conservative, We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help to win... [**That’s why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation of $35 or more today.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdgft5v75s4rrftpop4qd4j3f908k3812gn5q4qg_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctie9p34cjh2bs) We recently filed suit against a school AND the activists pretending to be teachers to make them pay for what they’re doing to our young and vulnerable children. Because the ONLY way we’re going to stop them -- is to make these extremists pay for their crimes... And that’s exactly what our landmark lawsuit does! Let me quickly give you the details in case you missed us while we were on **Laura Ingraham** ’s great **Fox News **show talking about our case: Jessica Konen, the mother of an innocent 12-year-old girl, was called into her daughter’s school and told that her daughter was now a “boy”. She found out that her young daughter had been groomed into believing she was “transgender” and “bisexual”... Her impressionable daughter didn’t even know these words until they were forced on her by these radicals. The school then pushed Jessica’s innocent daughter to create a whole new identity -- complete with a new boy’s name, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom... They also created a “Gender Support Plan” and ordered the faculty to use her new name and pronouns -- all without her mother’s knowledge! **And Jessica had no idea because her young daughter was told NOT to tell her mother since she couldn’t be “trusted”****.**
* These people are not real teachers.
* They’re not concerned with teaching our children to read...
* They’re not concerned with teaching our children math and arithmetic...
* They’re not concerned with teaching history...

They want to indoctrinate an entire generation of children to reject their parent’s values and embrace their radical Left-Wing propaganda -- and we have to stop them. [**That’s why I’m asking you to rush in your donation of $35 or more to help us stop these child groomers now.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zehqa9j0ffi1huj183k7hmu6h7noum7gjsu5g1fo_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctie9p34cjh2bs) After all this, Jessica did what any good mother would do and questioned the principal about what was happening to her young daughter at school... ... And what happened next? Child Protective Services was called to her house and “interviewed” her children! This grooming is happening behind closed doors in classrooms across the country... And it’s happening in secret so parents, grandparents andthe community don’t know what’s going on. Jessica’s innocent daughter is just one of the countless victims -- and if we don’t act, there will be more and more every day... Since we announced our lawsuit **The Ingraham Angle** , tons of concerned parents, grandparents and teachers have reached out to us. It’s horrible and sickening that this is happening, but we have to stop it... And our lawsuit is the key. Political pressure and new laws will not work -- we must drag these radical activists and schools into court and make them pay. That’s why our lawsuit names the individual “teachers” -- we must hold **them** accountable... Only when these extremists are scared of being dragged into court and are forced to pay will they stop. Make no mistake -- if we win this landmark case every single one of these so-called teachers will take notice. They will think of the consequences before pushing their radical agenda on our vulnerable children... [**So please, join me today with a donation of $35 or more to fund our lawsuit to protect our kids from out of control leftist teachers.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zbou26f1m58htf58g12m4gnvikemv6i0cqri5m5o_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctie9p34cjh2bs) But to stop them, we need to win this case... And if you can give more today – $50, $100, $250 or more – I will use it to protect our children and our constitutional rights from these radical Left extremists. But, whatever amount you can send, I ask that you rush it in right away. And please know that here at the Center for American Liberty we don’t just file lawsuits – we **WIN** them!! We recently won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court and we’re fighting Big Tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives... But this case to stop these extremists from corrupting and damaging our innocent children is too important to lose. And the only way to stop them is to make them know we’re going to make them pay for their actions... [**So please, join the fight today****with your emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100 or more today.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zedfidbtq24uroc1ugmbmdr6strgf7bul2j7kfl0_rp22sh2s8i66or3ctie9p34cjh2bs) We’re ready to go to the mat to win this case, but we can’t do it without you. Thank you in advance for your support. Sincerely,

Friend,
**After last night’s debate, there is much to unpack — so let’s get started on breaking down the top issues in Pennsylvania and what the candidates had to say about them.**
Across Pennsylvania, voters have expressed interest in funding public schools and ensuring quality education, protecting reproductive rights, and strengthening our economy.
Before Fetterman ran for office, he was inspired to help his community in Braddock, PA. In his 13 years as mayor, John worked to rebuild his community, creating jobs, getting youth engaged, and bringing creative urban policy solutions to Braddock. He continued helping his community after being elected as lieutenant governor.
He has proven that he will advocate for our youth across Pennsylvania, but he demonstrated it again last night with these words: “Education should be affordable AND universities should pay their employees a livable wage.”
**[There’s no competition, Friend. We know who we need to vote for, and that’s John Fetterman — so let’s have our voices heard by making a plan to vote.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53375713/375243652/1454821037?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZTlkZjAzYS00NzU1LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=83doGPjUAiUb5nqTY0WZjiLGgppmkigPulcgQ4VvFCM=&emci=39070e1a-3655-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=2e9df03a-4755-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=6787172)**
When candidates were asked about supporting access to safe abortions, Mehmet Oz believes that “local political leaders" should determine your rights and refused to say how he'd vote on Senator Lindsay Graham's national abortion ban legislation. But Fetterman confidently stated, “If you believe your reproductive freedom belongs with you and your doctor, that’s what I’m fighting for. In the U.S. Senate, I would fight for _Roe v. Wade_ and codify it into law.”
We saw the passion and urgency in Fetterman’s words during the debate, but we have also seen the amazing strides he has made in office. We have the power to elect someone who will move Pennsylvania forward, not backward.
**[Friend, John Fetterman has fought like hell for us in office — let’s do the same for him by making a plan to vote in the upcoming election.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53375715/375243660/-111262904?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZTlkZjAzYS00NzU1LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=83doGPjUAiUb5nqTY0WZjiLGgppmkigPulcgQ4VvFCM=&emci=39070e1a-3655-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=2e9df03a-4755-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=6787172)**
Pennsylvania’s economy was another topic discussed by the candidates. Here’s how John Fetterman responded: “The Dr. Oz rule: If he’s on TV he’s lying. Dr. Oz is the person who actually has to answer for not paying taxes. I want to lower taxes for working families while making sure people with 10 houses pay their fair share,” while Oz circled around the question.
Younger Americans today are drowning in student debt and have had to postpone dreams of owning a home — all while corporate profits continue to grow, billionaires and the ultra-wealthy get richer, and older generations continue to build their wealth.
**We have had enough.** We are tired of the same tactics used by the GOP to bring us down, but together we will rise and fight for a just economy, quality education, and abortion rights throughout Pennsylvania.
**In less than 20 days, we have the opportunity to elect Fetterman and see progress in Pennsylvania, so let’s get ready to cast our ballots this November 8.**
[Make a plan to vote](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53375718/375243672/-1442076010?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZTlkZjAzYS00NzU1LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=83doGPjUAiUb5nqTY0WZjiLGgppmkigPulcgQ4VvFCM=&emci=39070e1a-3655-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=2e9df03a-4755-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=6787172 "Sign up to text")

clean_body: | | | Last night’s debate showed us who will advocate for us in office. Now it’s our turn to show up for John Fetterman. | | | Friend, After last night’s debate, there is much to unpack — so let’s get started on breaking down the top issues in Pennsylvania and what the candidates had to say about them. Across Pennsylvania, voters have expressed interest in funding public schools and ensuring quality education, protecting reproductive rights, and strengthening our economy. Before Fetterman ran for office, he was inspired to help his community in Braddock, PA. In his 13 years as mayor, John worked to rebuild his community, creating jobs, getting youth engaged, and bringing creative urban policy solutions to Braddock. He continued helping his community after being elected as lieutenant governor. He has proven that he will advocate for our youth across Pennsylvania, but he demonstrated it again last night with these words: “Education should be affordable AND universities should pay their employees a livable wage.” When candidates were asked about supporting access to safe abortions, Mehmet Oz believes that “local political leaders" should determine your rights and refused to say how he'd vote on Senator Lindsay Graham's national abortion ban legislation. But Fetterman confidently stated, “If you believe your reproductive freedom belongs with you and your doctor, that’s what I’m fighting for. In the U.S. Senate, I would fight for Roe v. Wade and codify it into law.” We saw the passion and urgency in Fetterman’s words during the debate, but we have also seen the amazing strides he has made in office. We have the power to elect someone who will move Pennsylvania forward, not backward. Pennsylvania’s economy was another topic discussed by the candidates. Here’s how John Fetterman responded: “The Dr. Oz rule: If he’s on TV he’s lying. Dr. Oz is the person who actually has to answer for not paying taxes. I want to lower taxes for working families while making sure people with 10 houses pay their fair share,” while Oz circled around the question. Younger Americans today are drowning in student debt and have had to postpone dreams of owning a home — all while corporate profits continue to grow, billionaires and the ultra-wealthy get richer, and older generations continue to build their wealth. We have had enough. We are tired of the same tactics used by the GOP to bring us down, but together we will rise and fight for a just economy, quality education, and abortion rights throughout Pennsylvania. In less than 20 days, we have the opportunity to elect Fetterman and see progress in Pennsylvania, so let’s get ready to cast our ballots this November 8. I’m running in this race to make sure that every Pennsylvanian has a fair shot at succeeding without being pushed to the sidelines.

Derek, it’s Josh Shapiro. I’m running for Governor to make a difference in the lives of every Pennsylvanian – because I believe that a Governor has the ability to shape the future for the better. I’m fighting like hell to make our Commonwealth one where people can live, work, go to school, and raise a family with dignity – not one where hardworking people have to struggle to make ends meet every month. I’m running in this race to make sure that every Pennsylvanian – no matter who they love, how they pray, what they look like, or what zip code they live – has a fair shot at succeeding without being pushed to the sidelines. Most importantly, I’m running for Governor so that I can protect our right to vote, marry who we love, make choices about our own bodies, and have access to a high-paying union job. It’s so simple, but that's what's at stake in this race and that’s what I’ll do as your next Governor. **[Derek, this election is about more than just my name on the ballot – it’s about a vision of a stronger, brighter future for Pennsylvania. Every vote matters and every dollar donated will help us make that vision a reality. Yesterday was not a good fundraising day, and that is putting it lightly. **If I'm being totally honest, it was the worst day of the month so far.**

I don't want to sound like an alarmist, but yesterday's fundraising totals shocked me to the core. Peter,

As a first-time candidate, I wouldn't consider myself a seasoned campaign operative. But one thing I have learned is that knocking on doors is one of the best ways to reach voters. body:
Since I have been in office, I have become the #1 target of the Left, the liberal biased media, and Big Tech giants like Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

| | | Peter,
Since I have been in office, I have become the #1 target of the Left, the liberal biased media, and Big Tech giants like Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

I have been smeared again and again by media companies like _The New York Times_ , _Washington Post_ , and the _Milwaukee Journal Sentinel_ where they distort my comments, twist them through a liberal prism, and omit most of what I actually say.

I have been silenced, censored, and suspended by the social media oligarchs because I tell the truth, and oftentimes, it is the truth the liberal mainstream media does not want to hear. It counters their narrative, and they refuse to allow it. So they silence free speech.

Yet, despite all of this unconstitutional collusion between these far-Left parties working for political gain at the expense of the American people, I will not give up. They will not deter me. And that is why today, I am officially announcing my re-election campaign for the Wisconsin Senate seat.

I am running for a third term for the simple reason that I believe I am the best person for the job. I believe that I am the best candidate to address the national debt, work to lower inflation, secure the border, and fight for America First policies. I believe I am the best candidate to put an end to the Biden administration's constant record of misinformation and their continued lack of transparency with Congress, the press, and you. I believe I am the best candidate for Wisconsin because I tell the truth and speak for the minority, even when the majority is doing everything they can to silence me.

Now that I have announced, the Left will seize every opportunity to destroy me politically. They will continue to write manipulative hit pieces and orchestrate smear campaigns across all mediums. They will attack and distort my record of success, my record of searching for the truth, and my record of fighting for the people of Wisconsin in any way they can.

And that's why I need your help.

subject: I’ve received death threats… here’s why
body:
This message — which the media forces Black Americans to listen to — is heartbreaking. And it needs to stop.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z8q52qa8s62v0hhqdaaplv9g5tcaspp8sbi09470_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ej3fctmekp76t1heipnacpne4pqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65t9heqrm4ctkcpprcork62om4dj1cpobec9heqor4s3gmlhbddtkcipn1d3leuoefkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj32c5lmhjrcoj66pibacb7m2qmash1k8gn48n24hhm6or0s1h61p72c8iv0)
[](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zdjm7l7v7fdp068mtlqa031952i2vn8974io6svo_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3g64o74s9h2bs)

Hello Friend,

I've dealt with racism before. . . I've even received death threats.

All because I am a Black woman with conservative values and because I believe that Black communities can overcome the victimhood mentality.

I've watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence for almost my entire life. Growing up, I remember being told I was "helpless."

This message -- which the media forces Black Americans to listen to -- is heartbreaking. _And it needs to stop_.

I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation with Brandon Tatum to promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthen the nuclear family, and foster a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

Our message to America's Black and minority communities is, _**" You don't have to be a victim."**_

[_**Will you please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission by helping me reach our goal of raising $50,000 from new online donors this month? You can **__**click here to donate >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zbmo58lgssfmpeg6s583rs4s7838vp314o41lopg_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3g64o74s9h2bs)

Black communities are taught to believe that we're victims, that nothing will ever change, that police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG! Giving up and becoming a victim is never the solution.

It's why BLEXIT is NOT just a "think tank," but a thoughtful and quick-acting "DO-tank." _**That 's all thanks to our BLEXIT State Chapters. **_

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the movement at the local, grassroots level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

Since 2019, BLEXIT has grown to reach 42 states with over 14,000 volunteers.

Friend, I am humbly asking you to support BLEXIT and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $50,000 this week to support our mission.

[_**Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z6o4542q7vh71bi7ln5ao6eehl2fqlp4s01mqqd0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3g64o74s9h2bs)

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values.

BLEXIT Chapters promote and encourage others to seek alternative educational opportunities in their local communities. Educational opportunities for America's low-income and minority children and empower them to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty.

[_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_
](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zsr4vckeuno3rnc3h29l4n8mul9q0p1vuupt2upg_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3g64o74s9h2bs)
* Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers, and this ugly message is setting Black Americans back.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice.

BLEXIT Chapter members lead educational programs to help communities avoid incarceration and foster better relationships between police officers and urban communities.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by donating here >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2znjl7j94qumtv76s9def1ofnbfd6c6d6mhm1t98o_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3g64o74s9h2bs)

* Entrepreneurship: Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not just talking a big game. . . Our Chapter members are actually connecting with community individuals to make a real impact in urban communities.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zqtpn7ko0u1vkf8ps3hja7lahr83fumb1n71h9ho_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3g64o74s9h2bs)

* Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. Our urban communities must learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens.

It's why BLEXIT holds summer and after-school programs to teach children about these important lessons.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z291lqljkikusb597qeav6abk0nu87tgmv6b1cuo_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3g64o74s9h2bs)

* Presenting Our Message: The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. These are urban communities that others ignore, communities that rely on the mainstream media to write their narrative.

These aren't boring events, and we're not just preaching to the choir. They have music, art, and real conversations. Most importantly, they are fun!

These exciting events are brought to life because of our State Chapters. Their hard work and creativity help our message reach new people and inspires communities to be victors, not victims.

[_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zsrl5q1tonof570qd8th4fet5to9o7ljfvbjbj88_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3g64o74s9h2bs)

This is personal to me -- I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood, but now I found my exit.

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence forced upon us.**If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor.**

I've been dragged through the dirt to protect my country \- and I'm proud of it.

If I win my race, I'll be the only Black Conservative Woman in Congress, but that doesn't matter to me.

I cannot complete this mission alone, not with Nancy Pelosi using her hundred million bucks to bury patriots like me. To Pelosi, I'm a THREAT to her corruption and must be stopped.

[Peter, I'm personally asking: will you chip in a few bucks today to help me win my race and fix the American Dream Washington has broken?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736779:JHlgXjGlN:m:1:3359512271:329DC266431EB1A192701D2ABB945C41:r)

The future of America is on the line - and what happens today will decide everything.

We don't have any more time to sit around and wait. We MUST stand up and act now.

[So please, please help me win today. I promise you that I'll earn that contribution you gave me to get to Congress.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736779:JHlgXjGlN:m:1:3359512271:329DC266431EB1A192701D2ABB945C41:r)

Jennifer-Ruth Green

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

| | | Friends, The Establishment operates at a full-time capacity - 365 days a year. Same with the woke bureaucrats and the agencies they run. Same with the lobbyists and the corporations that fund them. But part-time lawmakers usually head back home after their legislative session is over, leaving the Establishment to control the agenda for months and months on end. **_The State Freedom Caucus Network puts a stop to that_**. We help part-time lawmakers become a full-time counterforce to the Establishment. Even when they are out of session, state freedom caucuses are pushing back against the Radical Left and the GOP Establishment that often enables them. Here are just some of the things the state freedom caucuses have been doing lately: The **Illinois Freedom Caucus** is demanding that Chicago’s Lurie Children’s Hospital stop providing transgender services to innocent children. Thanks to the ILFC’s efforts, the issue is becoming a wedge of contention in the governor’s race. From a [local press story](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=4b19d20fb6&e=64ecec6d03): “Gov. J.B. Pritzker and GOP nominee Darren Bailey were asked about gender-affirming care for Illinois youth as the November election nears...The Illinois Freedom Caucus, which consists of state lawmakers who support Bailey, said it will introduce legislation "to ban chemical castrations and gender surgeries for minors in Illinois." Until that is approved, the group called on the Ann and Robert H. Lurie Children's Hospital of Chicago "to cease providing these services to minors." The **South Carolina Freedom Caucus** is trying to end abortion completely in their state. But “Republican” members of the state senate are trying to expand abortion beyond what’s in current law! | | | Peter - This is Dr. Oz.

I've given out a lot of advice on skincare over my long career. But now I'm asking you to put some skin in the game.

Traveling across Pennsylvania, I've heard from thousands of Americans about the daily struggles they face in the Biden era. I'm hearing one thing loud and clear: _addressing those challenges is at the very bottom of Biden 's to-do list._

Instead of focusing on the price of gas, food, and other essentials, Biden and the Democrats are far more concerned about transgender athletes and the Green New Deal.

**NOW** , we're hearing that my leftist opponent, John Fetterman, thinks the administration hasn't gone far enough!

We can't allow John Fetterman to double down on Biden's failed agenda and lead us further down the road to socialism. That's why I'm coming to you for help.

Dr. Oz
