No one is left out and no one is taken for granted.
| | |
---
Peter, Election Day is less than 2 weeks away, and I'm about to ask you to make a donation to my campaign. **Can you give me a moment to explain why this race is so important – and why your donation tonight matters so much?[(If you're in a hurry but ready to donate right now, here's the best link to give!)](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53385517/375278873/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk399-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MDhhZTFiMS01ODU1LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=azUQrg8dZxTUk9Q2Jd_bVv3DqH0NmUZaBx2wV5t_xMI=)**
**I have found meaning and purpose in my life by serving others and caring for my community – as a nurse, a volunteer, an advocate, and a mother.** I've held patients' and family members' hands during their most difficult moments. I've cared for hospice patients in their homes and nursing homes. I've advocated for some of the most vulnerable children and adults in our state. And I did everything within my power to help my beloved son recover from his opioid addiction.
**This work has led to some of the most meaningful connections of my life and opened up my eyes to experiences wholly unlike mine. It’s been one of the greatest honors and privileges of my life to meet and listen to so many Missourians these last few months.**
In the Senate, I promise that I will be a leader for every family in this beautiful state. Whether you live in a big city like St. Louis or a rural town like Eldon. Whether you vote red or blue, or not at all. Whatever your background, beliefs, and hopes for the future, there is a place for you in this movement.
**No one is left out and no one is taken for granted.**
But if you are in this fight with me, I need you to be in it _right now._
**Our final end-of-month deadline is just around the corner and everything that we've worked for is going to come down to these final weeks.[So please, Peter, if you believe in a kinder, more honest Washington, will you make a donation to power our campaign through the last 13 days of this election?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53385518/375278874/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk399-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MDhhZTFiMS01ODU1LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=azUQrg8dZxTUk9Q2Jd_bVv3DqH0NmUZaBx2wV5t_xMI=)**

subject: Voting by mail? You have a few days to request a ballot.

body:
https://www.kpef.info [https://www.kpef.info]

Dear Friend,

Are you voting by mail? We're sharing the info you need to get your ballot, and get it in on time — because we know how powerful each of our ballots are — especially in an election as critical as this.

First and foremost: November 1, 2022, is the last day to apply for a mail-in or absentee ballot. Your application must be received by your county election board [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Resources/Pages/Contact-Your-Election-Officials.aspx] by 5 p.m. that day.

If you're a registered voter, you can request a mail-in ballot here [https://www.pavoterservices.pa.gov/OnlineAbsenteeApplication/#/OnlineAbsenteeBegin] . And if you're a voter with disabilities or an illness that prevents you from going to your polling place on Election Day, or if you'll be out of town that day, you can request an absentee ballot here [https://www.pavoterservices.pa.gov/OnlineAbsenteeApplication/#/OnlineAbsenteeBegin] .

Make sure to fill it all out — sign, date, seal, stamp, and put it in the mail ASAP. For details on how to fill out your ballot, click here [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Voting-in-PA/Pages/Mail-and-Absentee-Ballot.aspx] .

Your mail-in ballot has to be received by 8 p.m. on Election Day, November 8. So, if you don't think it'll make it on time by mail, bring your ballot to a drop box or Election Office . Find a drop box here [https://vote.pa/return/] and find your county election office here [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Resources/Pages/Contact-Your-Election-Officials.aspx] .

Please remember, if you don't receive your ballot in the mail at all, then contact your local election office [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Resources/Pages/Contact-Your-Election-Officials.aspx] . If you had an emergency [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Voting-in-PA/Pages/Mail-and-Absentee-Ballot.aspx#emergency%20absentee] and missed the deadline to vote by mail, see about getting an emergency absentee ballot here [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Voting-in-PA/Pages/Mail-and-Absentee-Ballot.aspx#emergency%20absentee] .

If you need any additional information, visit our voting guide below.

KEYSTONE PROGRESS’ HOW TO VOTE GUIDE [https://www.kpef.info/pa-voter-guide]

Check the status of your ballot here [https://www.pavoterservices.pa.gov/Pages/BallotTracking.aspx] , and if you have any trouble voting, call 866-OUR-VOTE [tel:8666878683] .

Please forward this to your family and friends — this election is too important to miss, especially in PA where our rights and democracy are on the line.

We'll see you at the polls!

Laura
Executive Director
Keystone Progress

| Hi ,

I hope you are doing well. I want to take a moment to thank you personally for your incredible support and generous donations. We couldn't be doing this without you!!

When Brian first mentioned running for Governor, I was hesitant.

However, over the last few years, we've seen the intensity of policies come out of the Legislature that are not just alarming, but dangerous.

And honestly, upon reflection, it was only natural for Brian to run.

Brian's faith and commitment to our family and future generations have always been at the forefront: we're farmers. We steward the land for future generations.

Some may think it's impossible, but we don't.

In fact, being on the campaign trail up and down our state has proven one thing--people know California is heading in the wrong direction, and they want it to change.

They want to afford to put food on their tables.

They want to afford to fill up their gas tank.

They want to walk down the street without fear of being assaulted, and

They want great schools for their children.

Whether Democrat, Independent or Republican, it doesn't matter.

Californians are tired of what they are receiving from the current Administration.

As Brian is out campaigning, I know they see the Brian I know and love---hardworking, loyal, and committed to doing right by Californians.

In closing, could I ask you to share this email and do everything you can to get your friends, coworkers, and family to VOTE.

Every single vote matters.

Thank you!

\- Assemblywoman Megan Dahle

Hello Friends,
Over the next 13 days ahead of November 8th, voters across America are weighing in between Democrats who put People Over Politics and Republicans who blocked progress and are threatening another Trump tax scam for the top 1%, cuts to your earned Social Security, Disability Insurance and Medicare benefits, and a draconian national abortion ban.
Democrats must win this election – and we will win because of you, our Volunteers in Politics, who help us to own the ground in battleground districts to hold our House Democratic majority.
Join me tonight for an organizing session and discussion with my Special Guest, Congresswoman Julia Brownley from California, a champion for veterans, women’s rights, and a clean energy future. Register to join us TONIGHT, October 26 at 4PM PT / 7PM ET:
https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_JYscYwqhRpKk-WnnUz0KJQ [https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_JYscYwqhRpKk-WnnUz0KJQ]

A champion for our personal freedoms, women’s rights and women’s voices, Rep. Brownley is also the Founder and Chair of the Women Veterans Task Force.
Republicans have endless dark special interest money – but we Democrats have YOU, our VIPs. Our Volunteers in Politics will be the difference for us on Election Day!
We don’t agonize – we organize! And working together we will WIN.

Peter,

**They just keep moving the ball on me; I feel like I can't get a break, and to be honest with you it's exhausting.** The Republican Party big-wigs in D.C. keep hedging their bets and won't commit to sending me help because **they're somehow _still_ not sure that I'm worth the investment. **

Instead of putting money into my race, **they're spending millions on seats we can't win.** But, as a former national guardsman, I know how to play by the rules and take orders; **here is hoping you can help me meet the requirements they've set in order to barnstorm the state with money to help me secure victory.**

**National Republicans want me to raise $100,000 by the end of the month (October 31st), and they'll make an investment in my race; if i can't, I'll be on my own till the end.**

With only days to go, we’re still short about $8,000. **[If you’re in a position to give, would you make a generous contribution to my campaign today?](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=f861d18fb97a4a61bae2e942e4370ec3&_e=NphhbZKiMWnhEdRdMFBbhFvZbVVCWFHR9z0fAQvq28gCvorI76J1bytJJFlduGn_-1uVLORvI7NGwyMPS7OynlK0iN0P1YmicJVu4bDmpTRtN_t9u8WeLS_TEaBUEaCYr-zl4wgiV_JEupfRQtM_n1Aj6_HV2UctTcLLaKhu0H2xZ8hFYNHwxX_02hlMMkxgK1hiS4XTj-xGgfotrbqlx61rgK99uv7SrI-ZtbJnCFHGlP0qOJ1--BbBVZIEoyQgDJwKEh-r8jtzYbaedSNiD24IuqZdX8d_QKp2OQ5scJIcUFuVhWEz9gKSSBYtmk07wJ7S73JUwe0HU-Ch9Zt4e-SWEZxbI0AgjkplT7c6KqsCV7eK7rA1ry0qeWMrT9JPPlZfalZmEI7rdduXBE68DQ%3D%3D)**

**[If you’re on the fence about donating to my campaign, remember this race has national implications. The outcome of my race could well determine which party controls the House next year.](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=f861d18fb97a4a61bae2e942e4370ec3&_e=NphhbZKiMWnhEdRdMFBbhFvZbVVCWFHR9z0fAQvq28gCvorI76J1bytJJFlduGn_-1uVLORvI7NGwyMPS7OynlK0iN0P1YmicJVu4bDmpTRtN_t9u8WeLS_TEaBUEaCYr-zl4wgiV_JEupfRQtM_n1Aj6_HV2UctTcLLaKhu0H2xZ8hFYNHwxX_02hlMMkxgK1hiS4XTj-xGgfotrbqlx61rgK99uv7SrI-ZtbJnCFHGlP0qOJ1--BbBVZIEoyQg5XpbkvTTR1oDfyYaU2IclTaO1_kv3sNRuPtnN8sUqow-hvb0sSIpd_yA92k19e6_neWf3_GbKDNo24CLNS6nancLSOzFRDC67otoJFnOV54qlbbJjajhuZ1WOCdIB7LfRsVLc7HpiUPSN1nY9M4nmw%3D%3D)**

body:
I’m fighting for everyone in PA who’s gotten knocked down and had to get back up.
#
Hi Derek, it’s John Fetterman.
Last night, Dr. Oz and I debated in Harrisburg for the first and only time and I wanted to reach out about it.
**My stroke knocked me down, but I got back up. And now, I’m fighting for everyone in PA who’s gotten knocked down and had to get back up.**
**[If you have my back, can you chip in any amount to my campaign right now? Your support will carry me from today to Election Day, and I’m just so deeply grateful.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221026-1?refcode=em20221026-7889&refcode2=7889_434096_yDO77C&akid=7889%2E434096%2EyDO77C)**
Like I said last night, I’m fighting for real people all across PA + all across the country — from protecting women’s reproductive freedom, to raising the minimum wage, to protecting Social Security.
Meanwhile, Dr. Oz continued his old trend: Lying on TV + taking advantage of everyday people for his own personal profit.
**[If we’re going to defeat Dr. Oz + flip PA blue on November 8, I need you in my corner over these next 13 days. Will you rush a donation of any amount to my campaign right now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221026-1?refcode=em20221026-7889&refcode2=7889_434096_yDO77C&akid=7889%2E434096%2EyDO77C)**

Thank you so much for all your support, Derek.
I couldn’t do this without you.
❤️ John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: This is a long, but very personal message
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736803:6VqMSjGNN:m:1:3365131770:083F386134433D6E4888B8A2728BA7A3:r "I helped out on my
family's farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736803:6VqMSjGNN:m:1:3365131770:083F386134433D6E4888B8A2728BA7A3:r "I went on to play
soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736803:6VqMSjGNN:m:1:3365131770:083F386134433D6E4888B8A2728BA7A3:r "I married my high
school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736803:6VqMSjGNN:m:1:3365131770:083F386134433D6E4888B8A2728BA7A3:r "Scotty was
severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736803:6VqMSjGNN:m:1:3365131770:083F386134433D6E4888B8A2728BA7A3:r "Since that day
I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736803:6VqMSjGNN:m:1:3365131770:083F386134433D6E4888B8A2728BA7A3:r "Scotty went on to
serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736803:6VqMSjGNN:m:1:3365131770:083F386134433D6E4888B8A2728BA7A3:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736803:6VqMSjGNN:m:1:3365131770:083F386134433D6E4888B8A2728BA7A3:r "In 2007, we
welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736803:6VqMSjGNN:m:1:3365131770:083F386134433D6E4888B8A2728BA7A3:r "Washingtonians
need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736803:6VqMSjGNN:m:1:3365131770:083F386134433D6E4888B8A2728BA7A3:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736803:6VqMSjGNN:m:1:3365131770:083F386134433D6E4888B8A2728BA7A3:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736803:6VqMSjGNN:m:1:3365131770:083F386134433D6E4888B8A2728BA7A3:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---

Hello everyone,
My husband Michael and I had the privilege of serving our nation together for almost three decades.
Different schools, new doctors, different commute, pack up and unpack, good-byes to old friends and hellos to new neighbors — we moved from state-to-state and overseas. I didn’t know married life to a naval officer would be so busy or so enriching when we married in 1989. (Yes, I would do it over again!)
As a family, we were better for it. Our children saw many new schools, sometimes as many as three in a single year, and they were accepting of those disruptions to their lives. Deployments were made more tolerable when email came along, but Michael’s absence was always felt around the dinner table, on holidays, and during family events.
**No challenge we faced these last three decades, though, compares to the demands of running for the U.S. Senate.** Yet this is exactly why my husband is undertaking this next level of service — because he has consistently made the impossible look doable and the difficult look commonplace. If anyone can beat Chuck Grassley, he can do it. My sense is that the nation needs people like him.
Admiral Michael Franken, my hubby, is the right person to be Iowa’s next Senator. I believe in him, and I know he will wow you, as well. His soul is Iowa’s. **But if Mike is going to win, turn Iowa blue, and fix the many challenges Iowa, its citizens, and this nation face, he needs your help today.**

body:
Our rights are at stake this November. That’s why we need your help.

|

Derek, You all already know how important this midterm election is. The stakes have been clear for months: if Democrats don’t keep the House and the Senate, then the Democratic agenda that we’ve been working so hard to pass will be halted by a resentful GOP. The prospect of Speaker Kevin McCarthy should be enough to scare us into action. We know a Republican Congress will work to chip away at a woman’s right to choose, undermine the democratic process, and foster resentment towards our nation’s public education system. **This isn’t the America we want, and it’s not the America Virginians need.** But, it isn’t too late. With so many competitive seats on the ballot this year – like Congresswomen Luria, Spanberger, and Wexton’s races right here in the Commonwealth – we have the opportunity to hold the House, but only if we all work together. That’s why I’m asking for your help. **[Can I count on you to support the Virginia Democrats as we fight to hold every Democratic seat in the Commonwealth and do our part to keep the House blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53389897/375294743/1206354275?refcode=dpva-em-221025-susan&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYjBjZTY5My02NDU1LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9nImOUYVhfPyAP4Z9HaenT3sVc1FnZMO10BnGIajguY=)** With only a few weeks until Election Day, your support is more critical now than ever before. clean_body: Our rights are at stake this November. That’s why we need your help. | Derek, You all already know how important this midterm election is. The stakes have been clear for months: if Democrats don’t keep the House and the Senate, then the Democratic agenda that we’ve been working so hard to pass will be halted by a resentful GOP. The prospect of Speaker Kevin McCarthy should be enough to scare us into action. We know a Republican Congress will work to chip away at a woman’s right to choose, undermine the democratic process, and foster resentment towards our nation’s public education system. This isn’t the America we want, and it’s not the America Virginians need. But, it isn’t too late. With so many competitive seats on the ballot this year – like Congresswomen Luria, Spanberger, and Wexton’s races right here in the Commonwealth – we have the opportunity to hold the House, but only if we all work together. That’s why I’m asking for your help. = With only a few weeks until Election Day, your support is more critical now than ever before. Thanks for all you do to help us in our battle to hold the House. body:
| I had to take a moment to share with you some of the thoughts I’ve had over the past few years, while serving on the Intelligence Committee — the committee Kevin McCarthy intends to remove me from if Republicans retake the House.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=1187%2E5257348%2EaFc36n)
Derek, I know we are in the heat of election season, and you’re getting a lot of emails. Trust me, I am too. That’s why this email is a little bit different.
Because I had to take a moment to share with you some of the thoughts I’ve had over the past few years, while serving on the Intelligence Committee — the committee Kevin McCarthy intends to remove me from if Republicans retake the House.
As Republicans and their allies in the right-wing media have embraced Donald Trump and his lies and eschewed American democracy, so too have they embraced far-right autocrats and strongmen around the world.
They won’t say a cross word about Vladimir Putin.
They continue to threaten aid to Ukraine — from Trump blackmailing President Zelensky for dirt on Joe Biden, which led to his first impeachment, to Kevin McCarthy threatening to cut off aid to Ukraine if Republicans retake the House.
They are also great fans of far-right Hungarian prime minister Viktor Orbán, so much so that Tucker Carlson spent an entire week hosting his Fox News misinformation hour from Hungary.
Then CPAC, the Conservative Political Action Conference of American politicians, even selected Hungary as the international destination of their conference. Seriously.
If that wasn’t enough, Republicans invited the anti-immigrant, anti-LGTBQ Orbán to give a keynote address at CPAC Texas. Trump welcomed his “friend” Orbán to his golf club in New Jersey, too, after hosting him at the White House during his presidency.
__This isn’t just playing footsie with autocrats. It’s a full-on bear hug. And Republicans know exactly what they’re doing.__
Derek, you may not be familiar with every far-right politician in the world. But Republican leaders in Congress have worked hard to befriend them. And as they have continued to embrace Trump’s authoritarian tendencies, they look not to Lincoln, Roosevelt, or Kennedy for inspiration, but to Putin, Orbán, and other right-wing tyrants.
This is not by accident. The political project of Trumpism is to replace liberal American democracy with a system where voting rights, civil liberties, and freedom itself are subject to limits imposed by right-wing authorities — not our Constitution or our rule of law.
The United States is engaged in a global struggle against authoritarianism, and that is a fight that we cannot afford to lose.
So I am asking you, Derek, to help the United States continue to be a champion of freedom, democracy and human rights — at home and abroad. This struggle is too important to sit in the sidelines. Everyone needs to do their part, and I need your help.
**[Please, pitch in whatever you can spare today to help resist the global tide of authoritarianism, defend our House majority, and defend our democracy.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2022_abs_em.ghQTJ3&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20221026_AM1_V1_S1_VSP&email=&t=4&akid=1187%2E5257348%2EaFc36n)**

We need to tackle transportation pollution.
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4361?t=2&akid=13109%2E53494%2EXgrX6y) Friend, In June, President Biden said "I will do everything in my power to clean our air and [...] protect our people's health." Cars and trucks are the biggest source of greenhouse gas pollution in the U.S., impacting both our health and our climate. But despite Biden's promise, EPA still needs to accelerate on strong vehicle emission standards. **If EPA doesn't speed up these rules, they may not take effect before the end of Biden's first term, and we may not reach Biden's climate goals.** [_**We can't miss this chance to save lives: Sign our petition to EPA Administrator Regan demanding they act NOW to reduce dangerous transportation emissions!**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4361?t=3&akid=13109%2E53494%2EXgrX6y) | [SIGN ON](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4361?t=4&akid=13109%2E53494%2EXgrX6y)
---
Here's what's at stake:
* EPA can lower pollution for cars made between 2027-2030—but they must act now to make sure the new rule is effective.

* EPA proposed a rule to reduce pollution from heavy-duty trucks by 60% by 2045—but seven months later, they still haven't finalized it.

* Earlier this year, California submitted a waiver to EPA asking permission to regulate truck pollution even further, inspiring five other states to follow suit. But EPA has yet to approve this life-saving request.

Through it all, communities of color continue to suffer the worst effects of transportation pollution. **Disproportionate rates of asthma, lung cancer, and heart disease make it clear: This is an urgent environmental justice issue.**
[_**Join us in telling EPA Administrator Regan to accelerate the pace of clean car and truck standards to protect our communities now!**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4361?t=5&akid=13109%2E53494%2EXgrX6y)
Onward,
Rachel Patterson

body:
Our campaign is different, Team. Let me explain:

Team — we’re a few days away from our FINAL monthly fundraising deadline of the campaign, and we’ve fallen behind on our fundraising goal at the worst possible time. **[If you already know you’re with me, I’m humbly asking you to pitch in a few dollars today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53376346/375245734/-1064909629?refcode=email_102622_bio&amount=20&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTAxNzI5My00NzU1LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1BJdcLJ6z3Mv027uIT8-T-dQiPxu9uMYH7UGd5pSD30=)** | | [RUSH $20 NOW →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53376350/375245742/-1064909629?refcode=email_102622_bio&amount=20&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTAxNzI5My00NzU1LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1BJdcLJ6z3Mv027uIT8-T-dQiPxu9uMYH7UGd5pSD30=)
---
But if not, let me explain a bit about this campaign.
My team and I have talked a lot about how vital winning this race is for protecting our Democratic House majority. Right now, the polls show a neck-and-neck fight. But I’m not just asking for your support because of the (D) next to my name. I’m asking you to invest in this movement because of what I stand for, and my record of delivering for Coloradans.
So here are three things I’d like you to know about me:
**1) There aren’t a lot of people with my life experience in Congress.** I started cleaning houses when I was just 12 years old, worked behind the counter at a bagel shop, pushed carts at a grocery store, and waited tables at restaurant after restaurant.
So when I say I’m fighting for the regular people whose needs too often go overlooked by politicians who have no idea what it’s like to struggle to pay their bills — I really mean it.
**2) I know how to get things done, and I have the record to prove it.** As a State Legislator, I’ve fought to expand early childhood education and make kindergarten free, lower the cost of health insurance and prescription drugs, guarantee a woman’s right to choose, and help folks struggling with substance use disorder access treatment and recovery services.

Peter,

I know you're busy, but I need just a few minutes of your time.

__**[This is why I'm running.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61738342:6UN-5jGJN:m:1:3371220873:5B06E19D3A42C2957801FA02E922DB8E:r "This is why
I’m running.")**__

I grew up on a small farm in Washington.

We didn't have much, but I learned the value of hard work at a young age. I learned _responsibility_. That is something that political elites will never understand.

As a former triage nurse, I have always been passionate about serving others in my community.

However, everything was tested when a suicide bomber in Iraq permanently blinded my husband, Scotty, and I was told his service was over.
_**The suicide bomber may have taken my husband's vision, but he didn 't take away our determination and drive for service over self.**_
That's how I found myself running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent because we deserve better.

With empty grocery shelves and unprecedented crime, I couldn't sit on the sidelines any longer.

_**[This country is worth serving and sacrificing for, but I need YOUR endorsement to continue my fight!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61738342:6UN-5jGJN:m:1:3371220873:5B06E19D3A42C2957801FA02E922DB8E:r "This country is worth serving and
sacrificing for, but I need YOUR endorsement to continue my fight!")**_

I'm not asking for money. _Today, all I 'm asking for is your endorsement. _

---
| | [ENDORSE TIFFANY SMILEY](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61738342:6UN-5jGJN:m:1:3371220873:5B06E19D3A42C2957801FA02E922DB8E:r "ENDORSE TIFFANY SMILEY")
---

We're just weeks away from the General Election, and I know the odds are against me.

However, I genuinely believe that America needs to restore its core values. If you think that too, please, _**[endorse me and join our team.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61738342:6UN-5jGJN:m:1:3371220873:5B06E19D3A42C2957801FA02E922DB8E:r "endorse me and join our team.")**_

It would mean the world to me.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

name: Charles Booker
subject: The government should not enforce personal beliefs on others
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

This weekend at an event in Bardstown, a woman showed up to heckle me. She
accused me of wanting to kill babies because I don’t believe the
government should deny women healthcare.

I responded with respect. I was brought up in a Pentecostal Church, which
teaches that abortion is wrong in all cases. For many in our Commonwealth,
that is a personal belief.

But let me be clear: the government should not be in the business of
enforcing personal beliefs on others.

My mom had two ectopic pregnancies -- she’s told her story of nearly dying
because she couldn’t get the health care she needed.

This is a complicated issue. And we can’t allow the government to decide
who gets health care and who doesn’t.

You can watch my response by clicking on the thumbnail below, and
[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18794?t=1001&akid=2665%2E346206%2EKUpLvj ]please consider pitching in $20 or more to help make sure every

name: Margaret Mary Dunn
subject: My police officer son is facing life in prison
body:
I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

Michael is a police officer who dedicated his life to keeping our community safe in Farmers Branch, Texas.

_**But now he might be facing a life sentence in prison for shooting a dangerous career criminal who tried to run Michael down in a stolen truck.**_

[**Will you help my son?**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dea29ee0116e4729b3f2b57618366cb0&_e=v57WxZCHYzsZcdPyv_KBSVn_PszvR_TyA45jR9AAWehMSNztxaSU9E_A-FZ6FB-ATP5leI5TFyz5bEl8yNaW6P2cWYWvkx1595vto6HZcrE6qaaKxYTdPE-bL46FSO8xTbvxQ6y0GVdWgp_itgFwxfRJSH9XkdCTBQ4v4FVqahrLxlk56P11U_mwM3oS3wuAEsmAjTVd5zU4mHUrEKWP6pgcnFM8IXbkO6vqSlk6M2TxRQ477s1LCrQuV8CYUqLuDFkwk7wKCr-elaPPFL_ozfDGw1p5moUUR6h3PDdlctQjaAfFRd6nUPtIulQs3XkvsSpF0GAqOIYH8aIFx7YysjUsUMYS2aU8AhSN8-25UM0%3D)

That's Michael in the photo.

[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dea29ee0116e4729b3f2b57618366cb0&_e=v57WxZCHYzsZcdPyv_KBSVn_PszvR_TyA45jR9AAWehMSNztxaSU9E_A-FZ6FB-ATP5leI5TFyz5bEl8yNaW6P2cWYWvkx1595vto6HZcrE6qaaKxYTdPE-bL46FSO8xTbvxQ6y0GVdWgp_itgFwxfRJSH9XkdCTBQ4v4FVqahrLxlk56P11U_mwM3oS3wuAXNkwoFLpi0tcsRzdP7YeVHb3ZrA8Hn-yz-T31knov8UNMA6LnrqPkpXGaJiYgJrwCIG-PcB5WjlLWFhDNOhd5zIhLTnd6scDdN6PsetRSi5f0-9HdEi3_t01pVoeP-O7QE6qNBHJmj9fjeN01TKZuB3BCIhBlUMRRq5TJ9POoio%3D) [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dea29ee0116e4729b3f2b57618366cb0&_e=v57WxZCHYzsZcdPyv_KBSVn_PszvR_TyA45jR9AAWehMSNztxaSU9E_A-FZ6FB-ATP5leI5TFyz5bEl8yNaW6P2cWYWvkx1595vto6HZcrE6qaaKxYTdPE-bL46FSO8xTbvxQ6y0GVdWgp_itgFwxfRJSH9XkdCTBQ4v4FVqahrLxlk56P11U_mwM3oS3wuAP2mO7z5Y1y22306hzn_XCeQjvLbWXTIfLCY1-0h-qFMqxtYto97ujFy6QKTy0ttLcL2LIGu-sJiGGSw1ivipBCGFK4N_4YsVBbMZ4j6B_Ub5btDGLcgBuFCBSV0YpA9SuVXupP5scJ6Xgfauz3AZjshKtJkHXh3DD6JICl99SaI%3D)

In addition to being a police officer, Michael is also a Master Gunnery Sergeant in the United Stated Marine Corps Reserve.

I knew when he joined the police department that it was a dangerous job.

Every night on the news I saw another story of a police officer ambushed or killed in the line of duty.

It's been a heart wrenching time for the families of police officers in recent years.

What I didn't expect was that so many Americans would turn their backs on Michael in his time of need.

I now realize that it's all about fear. Fear of being attacked as a racist.

Fear of going against woke politicians and bureaucrats.

Fear of losing their jobs.

I assumed that the police department, the prosecutor's office, and everyone else in the government and the community would have Michael's back.

**But I was wrong.**

_So_ _now_ _Michael 's_ _life_ _is_ _at_ _stake_ _for_ _simply_ _doing_ _his_ _job_ _and_ _we_ _have_ _nobody_ _to_ _turn_ _to_ _except_ _for_ _good_ _hearted_ _strangers_ _like_ _you._

**[Will you please help me save my son Michael?](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dea29ee0116e4729b3f2b57618366cb0&_e=v57WxZCHYzsZcdPyv_KBSVn_PszvR_TyA45jR9AAWehMSNztxaSU9E_A-FZ6FB-ATP5leI5TFyz5bEl8yNaW6P2cWYWvkx1595vto6HZcrE6qaaKxYTdPE-bL46FSO8xTbvxQ6y0GVdWgp_itgFwxfRJSH9XkdCTBQ4v4FVqahrLxlk56P11U_mwM3oS3wuAgEd9jS65JSLh1xUlZNS4jrQMsHUqJqH8J458pA8IYHz6ZM2BKIDcqS0fuW_lK2jBpj3RXJsyXLl45nAe3RggHNEXy9K2_wHgucY04w1Zibr5BYMJLwP3MASiByfIkuQRqkQfFVcZbraoNBHDcKP6RuXW9qgvmb49LDFQ8K8GLrQ%3D)**

Let me give you some more of the details...

Michael and other Farmers Branch Police detectives tracked a stolen pickup truck to the parking lot of an "adult arcade."

The truck was stolen by a convicted felon who was well-known to the police.

Michael was assigned the task of arresting this man.

When the suspect came back to the truck, Michael pulled up and stepped out of his police car.

The criminal sped the stolen truck toward him.

Michael had to do what every police officer hopes they never have to do: he drew his weapon and fired.

The man driving the stolen truck died at the scene.

My son suffered back and leg injuries.

Michael had a split-second to think about if the career criminal speeding toward him was going to crush him to death with that stolen truck.

In that split-second, he did what he needed to do in order to save his own life and the lives of his fellow officers and community.

There's no doubt in my mind, and many others, that Michael made the right choice that day.

He should be considered a hero for putting his life on the line to protect others.

But right and wrong seem to have been turned upside down in the last few years.

Why else would they be trying to put my son in prison for murder for what he did?

That's why I'm willing to do whatever it takes to clear his name. **[Even if that means asking folks like you for financial support to help my son afford the best possible attorneys and legal advice.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dea29ee0116e4729b3f2b57618366cb0&_e=v57WxZCHYzsZcdPyv_KBSVn_PszvR_TyA45jR9AAWehMSNztxaSU9E_A-FZ6FB-ATP5leI5TFyz5bEl8yNaW6P2cWYWvkx1595vto6HZcrE6qaaKxYTdPE-bL46FSO8xTbvxQ6y0GVdWgp_itgFwxfRJSH9XkdCTBQ4v4FVqahrLxlk56P11U_mwM3oS3wuApifYUdy4TbXrXMr7b3CspcBLmgriewNTeeCJHxdbALi0R2eKaZQ4w5rP3PuMI2MKBbcL6naqWqTiCTZERwg0h-n1c_hl44wLhWQULShAApqNDRBswX_7qPRRdDJWxRXBgZTI8ua1SvZYV-qIYksulkMNdo-zS7lCdjxpKn4uzC4%3D)**

After the incident, Michael was distraught to hear the criminal died.

But the other officers assured him the shooting was justified.

And then our whole world was rocked.

**Just 8 days after the incident Michael was indicted.**

Experts described the indictment as "unusually swift." The president of the Dallas Police Association said:

"We have never had an investigation completed in less than eight days ready to hand over to the District Attorney. Never."

I knew in my heart something was wrong - and we would be facing the fight of our lives to defend Michael in court.

We started a fundraising campaign on the internet site "GoFundMe" to raise money for a proper legal defense.

After a few days, "GoFundMe" shut down the fundraiser.

They claimed Michael's actions as a police officer were an "act of hate" - and helping him violated their terms of service.

So in this anti-police climate, politically woke climate, the case was closed in their minds.

No "innocent until proven guilty." No due process.

Instead, my son was smeared as a "murderer" who committed a "hate crime."

Since then, my husband and I spent half our life savings on legal fees and bills to help Michael.

_With the investigation devastating my family... seeing Michael, an American hero, being smeared on the internet... and our family quickly running out of money to pay mounting court fees... hope was fading._

Until we heard about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). **LELDF is the best friend a police officer could ever have.**

LELDF defends good officers, like my son, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.

The group's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.

And praise the Lord, LELDF saw it fit to help my son!

**[Will you please consider sending a tax-deductible contribution to the LELDF so they can help my son beat his charges?](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dea29ee0116e4729b3f2b57618366cb0&_e=v57WxZCHYzsZcdPyv_KBSVn_PszvR_TyA45jR9AAWehMSNztxaSU9E_A-FZ6FB-ATP5leI5TFyz5bEl8yNaW6P2cWYWvkx1595vto6HZcrE6qaaKxYTdPE-bL46FSO8xTbvxQ6y0GVdWgp_itgFwxfRJSH9XkdCTBQ4v4FVqahrLxlk56P11U_mwM3oS3wuA5GFDEjf3GWkkzO3UeESTJ_ca5l5UtlONBUSH2yrFHqJbHRn8bJEHsAL-jY_Y6eUutnaJSjmdwXmy3U1as_YOe7dlI3ObC5RiKoRqGwJAYCC3VVWhktIsRsJW4M-pqfBoEBkCwOvHxeQBcBKzuAGJ3DyylF_SSUCdxOs4XGKOaic%3D)**

You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. It doesn't receive any funds from the government to help our police officers.

Or, if the Lord has blessed you with the means to help with a **[gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more,](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dea29ee0116e4729b3f2b57618366cb0&_e=v57WxZCHYzsZcdPyv_KBSVn_PszvR_TyA45jR9AAWehMSNztxaSU9E_A-FZ6FB-ATP5leI5TFyz5bEl8yNaW6P2cWYWvkx1595vto6HZcrE6qaaKxYTdPE-bL46FSO8xTbvxQ6y0GVdWgp_itgFwxfRJSH9XkdCTBQ4v4FVqahrLxlk56P11U_mwM3oS3wuAGbHdeSqsED-XDrmM6YdzIlLDvjiyCfm1r8Km25rt_F8vTAp9vipRUaz5wMqilPLGSykry2AiPLuPI30UW1bEfi99zrerQeDpnKzVDwLztCZSKMvMi74KgcRnW7VLigR9Tbz2jSKUR6i9RDLbV-cjmesotFQnzCxuph-8VqThIs4%3D)** I pray you will consider doing so.

Please know any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing.

If you can't help financially today, I understand. And please keep Michael and our family in your prayers.

My son Michael is an American hero who served our nation and his community. He shouldn't be locked behind bars for defending his life from a career criminal.
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dea29ee0116e4729b3f2b57618366cb0&_e=v57WxZCHYzsZcdPyv_KBSVn_PszvR_TyA45jR9AAWehMSNztxaSU9E_A-FZ6FB-ATP5leI5TFyz5bEl8yNaW6P2cWYWvkx1595vto6HZcrE6qaaKxYTdPE-bL46FSO8xTbvxQ6y0GVdWgp_itgFwxfRJSH9XkdCTBQ4v4FVqahrLxlk56P11U_mwM3oS3wuAFclHNjmGfks37UrxjDA-4UUY9pIA4Q1yNDB8v3wIAbhP45_nJqif7PGMTd66CP2MpPi-FqgyTZbfPwmP4MKFhm9bbBRTA7XNl9VoMAQFaPXy_oV0kC6seq6KzdwfTUfig1yYrJFxbyX8cAWv7t0vK9Hc2EtdciS0lSoFImoI68k%3D)
_That's a picture of Michael with his daughter - my granddaughter - Mary-Kaitlyn_
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dea29ee0116e4729b3f2b57618366cb0&_e=v57WxZCHYzsZcdPyv_KBSVn_PszvR_TyA45jR9AAWehMSNztxaSU9E_A-FZ6FB-ATP5leI5TFyz5bEl8yNaW6P2cWYWvkx1595vto6HZcrE6qaaKxYTdPE-bL46FSO8xTbvxQ6y0GVdWgp_itgFwxfRJSH9XkdCTBQ4v4FVqahrLxlk56P11U_mwM3oS3wuAGV2oFB2x9OYQzKfxCYpNN4PBF_s8jRLx-L2f3Z-bPN73tgcBYGr1DgrQ81m6uXWCkYPLhjLlMxq7P6sCx_iO6wXV0JkwGewqXGCa5YY3RpUsXSJH1dC37vbd-MryTNxoMld8gJoL6mBSukS45uG6nqFRtwB_Wly9DWQl1DVgWH8%3D)
_That's a picture of Michael with his Son - my grandson - William_

I pray you never go through something like this. But if you do, may God touch the hearts of kind people to help you - just as I'm praying He'll touch your heart to help my son today.

Sincerely,

Margaret Mary Dunn

PS: LELDF relies on caring people like you to send donations so they can fight tooth and nail to help wrongly-accused police officers like Michael. And because LELDF is a non-profit, all donations are tax-deductible. Your kind **[donation today of $35, $50, or $100](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dea29ee0116e4729b3f2b57618366cb0&_e=v57WxZCHYzsZcdPyv_KBSVn_PszvR_TyA45jR9AAWehMSNztxaSU9E_A-FZ6FB-ATP5leI5TFyz5bEl8yNaW6P2cWYWvkx1595vto6HZcrE6qaaKxYTdPE-bL46FSO8xTbvxQ6y0GVdWgp_itgFwxfRJSH9XkdCTBQ4v4FVqahrLxlk56P11U_mwM3oS3wuAm2_-QSMT9xHTIakR0LUjAC4UEkVTHEgBdaaYZfIwM05NKaatawJEwSb_S-b-8w96GxJscZLHWSKzoK0O-nGMzCD65AqbArwbeYLnwqOOa4endnfaPQH1GRo7P4l3hjwW0buv32zGnpDmCEyadiVVQarMf9Meqlkr_RsmcFs1Ys0%3D)** to help Michael will mean so much to my family.

\----------------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.leldf.org**. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_

Instead, my son was smeared as a "murderer" who committed a "hate crime." Since then, my husband and I spent half our life savings on legal fees and bills to help Michael. With the investigation devastating my family... seeing Michael, an American hero, being smeared on the internet... and our family quickly running out of money to pay mounting court fees... hope was fading. Until we heard about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). LELDF is the best friend a police officer could ever have. LELDF defends good officers, like my son, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty. The group's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department. And praise the Lord, LELDF saw it fit to help my son! You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. It doesn't receive any funds from the government to help our police officers. Or, if the Lord has blessed you with the means to help with a I pray you will consider doing so. Please know any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing. If you can't help financially today, I understand. And please keep Michael and our family in your prayers. My son Michael is an American hero who served our nation and his community. He shouldn't be locked behind bars for defending his life from a career criminal. That's a picture of Michael with his daughter - my granddaughter - Mary-Kaitlyn That's a picture of Michael with his Son - my grandson - William I pray you never go through something like this. But if you do, may God touch the hearts of kind people to help you - just as I'm praying He'll touch your heart to help my son today. Sincerely, Margaret Mary Dunn PS: LELDF relies on caring people like you to send donations so they can fight tooth and nail to help wrongly-accused police officers like Michael. And because LELDF is a non-profit, all donations are tax-deductible. Your kind to help Michael will mean so much to my family. \---------------- More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. And remember - Blue Lives Matter! subject: Elissa’s opponent on abortion & gay marriage
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221026&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221026&amount=28]
Team,
Elissa’s opponent has proven time and time again he wants to turn back the clock for Michiganders.
Let’s recap:
Earlier this year, he sent out a fundraising text with a link to cancel “your child’s gender reassignment surgery.” The link directed to a donation page, that appeared to claim that recipients needed to make a contribution to his campaign in order to cancel this made-up appointment.
Then, in their latest debate, when asked if he accepted gay marriage, Elissa's opponent said “I’m not someone who favors that.” He went on to say that he supported the 2004 Michigan ballot measure that banned gay marriage and he voiced his opposition to the Supreme Court’s decision in Obergefell v. Hodges, the ruling that legalized gay marriage across the country.
Finally, there’s his “100% pro-life, no exceptions” stance on abortion. In his first debate with Elissa, he confirmed that he does not support any exceptions for abortion – including for rape and incest. He was asked about this view (which is completely out of step with the vast majority of Democrats, Republicans, and Independents in Michigan) four times. And each time, his robotic dodge was the same: “I’m pro-life.”
If the GOP flips the House, it’s quite possible he will be asked to vote on both a ban on abortion and vote on banning gay marriage. Those are very real issues, and while Elissa’s opponent has tried to dodge what he'd do, he’s made it clear where he stands.
Michiganders deserve a representative that will fight to preserve their personal rights – not take it away. With less than two weeks until Election Day – will you chip in to help us ensure Elissa’s opponent doesn’t turn back the clock in Congress? Ever since I refused to buckle from the pressure from Special Counsel Robert Mueller to testify falsely against President Donald Trump in return for vague promises of "leniency" in my sentencing after being convicted in a Soviet-style show trial for the entirely fabricated crime of "lying to Congress" about nonexistent Russian collusion, the Democrat/fake news media cabal has been out to get me. Strangely, the Department of Justice's press release on this matter was put out at midnight on November 3rd, 2020 which was both election day and the busiest media day of the year... The _New York Times, The Washington Post, The Wall Street Journal, MSNBC_ , and all the other fake media news outlets who had taken advantage of the unconstitutional gag placed on me by the judge in my case and who had depicted me as both a "traitor" and a "Russian spy," **neglected to report what even BuzzFeed admitted was a "vindication."** The Gateway Pundit was among the [few media outlets to report this startling development](https://102671.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=7v69qlcz5ndmyf1vy2&linkid=3&link=52741dc7a2d94cbda963a474e6714dbd). Roughly two weeks ago, Congressman Jamie Raskin, a member of the January 6th Committee, started tipping off reporters that the committee's final hearing would include shocking new evidence that placed me in the center of a conspiracy regarding the illegal acts at the Capitol on January 6th--odd since I was not at The Ellipse, did not march to the Capitol, and was not at the Capitol on that day. January 6th Committee staffers tipped other reporters that their final hearing would also reveal my central involvement in the efforts to "overturn" the electoral college certification of the election of Joe Biden, as well as my activities in a "War Room" at the Willard Hotel, which I was never in nor was I aware even aware of. Although I expressed my concerns about the anomalies and irregularities in the 2020 election results and the obvious fraud, I played no formal or informal role in the effort to delay the Electoral College certification. Sara Murray of _CNN_ - who had illegal possession of my sealed indictment at 6:00 A.M. on the day that 29-heavily armed FBI agents swarmed my home to arrest me for the benefit of _CNN_ cameras - actually contacted my attorney, Grant Smith, to tell him that the committee would present evidence "enmeshing" me in the January 6th events. She was wrong. That same day, we received the good news that my wife's cancer PET scan showed that she has now been free of the aggressive stage 4 cancer she was diagnosed with after my pardon, for 18 months. This proves the healing power of Jesus Christ. A week prior, _CNN_ and _MSNBC_ both aired leaked videos from the Committee which they claimed showed that it was always President Donald Trump's plan to dispute the 2020 election even if he "lost." In fact, the video they aired clearly shows me saying that Trump should declare victory only if the race was "up in the air"--precisely the same solid political and public relations advice former Secretary of State and the Treasury James A. Baker III gave to George W. Bush in 2000. More curious, however, was a video supplied by disgruntled Danish documentary filmmakers who were following me that day in which the camera bounces around wildly but in which an audio track simultaneously plays what sounds like my voice calling for violence after the election. At the January 6th Committee hearing, however, this same audio track was matched with a video of me walking through an airport wearing a "Trump 2020" Covid mask, and therefore, I am never actually seen saying the words attributed to me. body:
I’m out in the district today, wrapping up some final campaign stops for the day, and wondering when I’ll get a response from Tony Gonzales about a debate in this race.

In case you missed it, I sent a certified letter to Tony a few weeks ago challenging him to a debate — and I haven’t received a response yet.

To be clear, I believe the people of TX-23 deserve to hear us debate about the issues that matter most. We should be debating the future of the energy industry here in Texas, and our plans for TX-23: rural development, immigration reform, border security, and gun safety.

But Tony is choosing to stay silent. And the truth is, his plans for TX-23 are supported by his big-money backers, not the families of this district.

Tony knows that if he debates me — I will prove him to be the fraudulent leader that he is. So here’s how you can help: Make a donation now to help us dial up the public pressure on Tony to take part in a debate. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221020Debate_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=10&recurring=]

Tony’s voting record shows that he is only concerned with party politics. I believe we deserve a representative that is concerned about what’s best for the district.

I’m ready. And I’m fighting as hard as I can to unseat Tony in November. I’ve been traveling across the district meeting with voters, and the people WANT to see a debate between us.

The more noise we can make, the better. Rush $10 or any amount to help us send a message → https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221020Debate_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=10&recurring=true

Peter,

subject: Special Election House District 23
body:
Special Election for House District 23 In September, Governor Reeves announced the appointment of Representative Jim Beckett as Executive Director of the Mississippi Public Utilities Staff. To ac | |
---

| | | Special Election for House District 23 |
---|---|---
| |
---
In September, Governor Reeves announced the appointment of Representative Jim Beckett as Executive Director of the Mississippi Public Utilities Staff.
To accept the appointment, Beckett announced his resignation from the Mississippi House of Representatives.
The governor announced this week that on January 10, 2023, there will be a special election to fill the vacated position of State Representative District 23.
November 21, 2022 is the deadline to qualify.
Candidates must file a [Statement of Intent](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/bvAxdFRfLENirZ-YMIz2OA), a [Candidate Petition ](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/ollzty0z_GFq9h58iGrMBQ)containing the signatures of not less than 50 qualified electors of the district, and submit a $250 qualifying fee to the Secretary of State’s Office.
The Mississippi Freedom Caucus is looking for qualified candidates in District 23 to fill this vital role. If you are interested or know someone who is considering throwing their hat in the ring, have them complete the [Candidate Questionnaire ](https://www.votervoice.net/MSFreedomCaucus/Surveys/7903/Respond)to begin the process.
To find your district, [ Click Here and find out who represents you.](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/wbtUbksRBf_LLpcrCBnU4g)

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53380409/375261038/-766995749?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTY2NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZDkyN2FhMi00ZjU1LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vw_nZWL0FUaDLoFCsERDcCkZTjaYRLjll1WaXS2eBxs=&emci=eefd653b-3055-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=8d927aa2-4f55-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=15639879)

Hi team,

Last week, Ann took on her opponent Bryan Steil in a debate – and **_won_**.

Ann showed that without a doubt, she is the leader we need in office to deliver for the people of Wisconsin — while Bryan spouted out his party's rhetoric of misinformation to confuse and scare voters. **Here are just a few things that Bryan got wrong in yesterday's debate:**

1. He says he supports contraceptives, yet when put to a vote earlier this year, Bryan Steil **voted against** protections for contraceptives.
2. He called contraceptives a "chemical abortion pill". This **is completely false** and shows how Bryan Steil's misinformation is dangerous and puts women's lives at risk. Many people need birth control to treat life-threatening conditions and contraceptives help to do this.
3. He called student loan relief an "untargeted policy" for doctors and lawyers. This is false. The student loan relief is only eligible to those making less than $115k a year and cancels up to 20k in debt for those who need it. **The loan does not help elitist lawyers like Bryan Steil, and perhaps that is why he is so against the loan relief for others.**
4. He said that parents are losing their rights in our education system, but Ann is the only parent in this race. When Ann's children were in public school she consulted with the school district and knows **there are many avenues for parents to have input and involvement in their children's education.**

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. Will you help by making a contribution to the OLCV PAC today? If you are eligible for Oregon’s Political Tax Credit, you can give $50 (individual) or $100 (couple filing jointly) and get it back when you file your taxes! body:
To take back our nation.

| Friend,

This is Rudy. I'm humbly asking you to read my story and learn why I'm running to save the American Dream for the next generation.

_I was heartbroken the second I got the news of my friend and mentor Congresswoman Jackie Walorski & two of her young staff passing away in a tragic accident in early August._ **Her leadership and her dedication to serving others will never be forgotten.**

Jackie's drive and passion to ensure the citizens of Northern Indiana had a voice and true representation in Washington is one of the many reasons why I am proud to have stood beside her throughout the years.

**Today, I have a new opportunity as the new Republican nominee to carry on her legacy in the halls of Congress to continue her mission to bring true Hoosier common sense to D.C. I am honored to have the support of her family as I embark on this journey.

Look, Washington is missing leaders who are committed to protecting their local communities and fighting to restore America's strength at home and abroad. As a business leader who grew up in this district, my neighbors in Indiana-02 do not have to worry about me putting politics ahead of their best interests.**

Today we are seeing Nancy Pelosi and her radical Left allies take our country down a road that will be unrecognizable if not stopped immediately. Every day we are seeing the Pelosi-Biden agenda place new burdens on hard-working American families.

This November is our final time to hold the Left accountable and redirect our country from falling further into the depths of socialism. The Democrats know the walls are closing in on them, and they're DUMPING millions into every race on the map. Unfortunately, new data shows the momentum shifting in the Dem's favor. **[We need your support in the next 24 hours to help us claim victory!](http://links.thehousegop.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=00aab132262e4251a890899a4e4467e2&_e=11XrklEVUjHOMDBGQZbpLPOW-8URoYEM_kNsm1b2w-OPsSJXXJVj3vc6zof_0IEsiy5hXjHjapnxleK9QF7O6ISK8IaMx4ysiVgqJr-cbcso66nw3cxmDJgGSTvvBE6xvMVkwDs_ktZWHf6udU613RtZwvI1gK0G2r5laLN1UFALfiOtrfWZhf_jwTjFo1m4SWrQUruPx-MWySmVkjLmwojTXg-Sq61pnLbxHiR_aG-6BHXvvFY--81paWtZzoTKo___t7H7mPWNy62_ib_PTcPJpTWPb-KsnUgkmWEI6gm25z8dXU4P11wcoonrJPqNTp4U_k_7Y1kp4hkm7PAGMijBJd4QOneQmMh7gn20uTGXcz7rxz4ehR3yC220FMoo2ECqL03H2pvexLPLrppuz_nzCjIb9Ps4GoJloIiy1Vwuta8q-lyLcS1bGX5qOGNuglvfZ1a0ErU2JXFMrtCj8fEcDeY1Yuv73jmo86RWLBuFHH33k_cv4ufl1zm_3R9aR5xsvLZgEyZ9YNPDUVoj9Q%3D%3D)**

I was heartbroken the second I got the news of my friend and mentor Congresswoman Jackie Walorski & two of her young staff passing away in a tragic accident in early August. Her leadership and her dedication to serving others will never be forgotten. Jackie's drive and passion to ensure the citizens of Northern Indiana had a voice and true representation in Washington is one of the many reasons why I am proud to have stood beside her throughout the years. Today, I have a new opportunity as the new Republican nominee to carry on her legacy in the halls of Congress to continue her mission to bring true Hoosier common sense to D.C. I am honored to have the support of her family as I embark on this journey. Look, Washington is missing leaders who are committed to protecting their local communities and fighting to restore America's strength at home and abroad. As a business leader who grew up in this district, my neighbors in Indiana-02 do not have to worry about me putting politics ahead of their best interests. Today we are seeing Nancy Pelosi and her radical Left allies take our country down a road that will be unrecognizable if not stopped immediately. This November is our final time to hold the Left accountable and redirect our country from falling further into the depths of socialism. The Democrats are determined to win in Utah. Chuck Schumer knows a WIN here is the ONLY WAY the left can hold their majority.

Help me win and help Republicans take back the Senate majority. **I 'm counting on hearing from you.**

For America,
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61736832:J0bsRjG9N:m:1:3371812801:72540612ABB6C0DA3537F19559E12867:r)
Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

body:
I'm in a pickle without your help. I'm going to lose.

| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61738421:6jL1RjGcN:m:1:3368395361:8F7644B3AF425AFE29E21BBEFBEB27C6:r)
---
Peter,

With Election Day being less than two weeks away and my **FINAL FUNDRAISING DEADLINE BEING 6 DAYS AWAY** , I wanted to take a few minutes today to tell you a little bit about myself, my life story, and what is never going to change.

**__[My Upbringing](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61738421:6jL1RjGcN:m:1:3368395361:8F7644B3AF425AFE29E21BBEFBEB27C6:r)__**
I was raised in Zachary, Louisiana, where I was taught the values I live by today by my mother and father. Those same values that I fight each and every single day to protect. Values like hard work, dedication, and putting God and family first in everything.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61738421:6jL1RjGcN:m:1:3368395361:8F7644B3AF425AFE29E21BBEFBEB27C6:r)
After high school, I attended Vanderbilt University, graduated, and then went on to receive my law degree at the University of Virginia. I tell you that so you know that I know a little more about the law than the average pink-haired woker would like you to believe.

**__[So, what'd I do after college?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61738421:6jL1RjGcN:m:1:3368395361:8F7644B3AF425AFE29E21BBEFBEB27C6:r)__**
I was elected to five terms as State Treasurer where I managed the state's $10.6 billion investment portfolios. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer's Cabinet.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61738421:6jL1RjGcN:m:1:3368395361:8F7644B3AF425AFE29E21BBEFBEB27C6:r)
Then, I got my biggest call. **The call to help the people of Louisiana and America.**

**__[Time as U.S. Senator of Louisiana](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61738421:6jL1RjGcN:m:1:3368395361:8F7644B3AF425AFE29E21BBEFBEB27C6:r)__**
I was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2016 after being endorsed by none other than President Donald J. Trump. I serve on the Appropriations, Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs, Budget, Judiciary, and Small Business and Entrepreneurship committees in the U.S. Senate. I serve as the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Energy and Water Development for the Appropriations Committee, the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Federal Courts for the Judiciary Committee, and the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Economic Policy for the Banking Committee.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61738421:6jL1RjGcN:m:1:3368395361:8F7644B3AF425AFE29E21BBEFBEB27C6:r)
Every day for me is a new challenge, another day to serve the people of Louisiana, and another day to fight for our conservative values. You see, I'm always going to be **100% PRO-LIFE** , **PRO-GUN** , and **PRO-FREEDOM**. That's not going to change regardless of what the Neo-Socialist Left throws at me, and you can write that down and take it home to Mama.

**I 'm going to fight for your rights, your freedoms, and for a better future for our children.**

That won't change, I'd rather drink weedkiller than let the Socialist Left Agenda poison this country that we know and love so much.

**[So, now that I've given you my story, in a nutshell, I'm going to humbly ask for your support. I've got two Left-of-Lenin opponents running to defeat me because Nancy Pelosi likes me about as much as a cat likes swimming. I need you to rush whatever you're able below to make sure I have the resources necessary to fight for you and defend our nation.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61738421:6jL1RjGcN:m:1:3368395361:8F7644B3AF425AFE29E21BBEFBEB27C6:r)**

I'm running out of time. It's almost over for me unless I receive emergency support in the next week to defeat my Socialist opponents and win re-election in November. **_[Please rush an emergency donation below to help me hit my FINAL FUNDRAISING GOAL!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61738421:6jL1RjGcN:m:1:3368395361:8F7644B3AF425AFE29E21BBEFBEB27C6:r)_**

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d500d97fb82249f08968d8982d0c1135&_e=g-0rUsX7WZC6d1aeSgc4F4ToijRahOOocq6HQ8dxBmSrH50xlpOQrOP-GfhzRDwsO5TlJ4unoQKFikXa7k1-64qMMVX-MbKM2M15heBGuqa2NjlMT2AXr59RZNPsaKmBmcEC06hmdif5EM7B_vzW2aDL8-Z-RCzL52c3ZksSldfdSG33lrH519e_GoBPStCcimxiez1ZWrMzr0Wq9_QmLnGj008wKMto8khQ3YbVjh97gD6Sr-XejoyPVGwmFhhvUJSo-04SrMD8ts0nYAEwOG6vPrf42NBNtJgeLeTZYBmQaixApCukHZre5CTZBqLu0v7-nT7LMCF0sE5ZZUofzj0_8imhR4E8bjayzaIFwNeW7G0DgUHBltgap9B53DpQ)**

* Overpopulation is destroying the world

We hope you’ll take a moment to read it from beginning to end and hear why Delaware is so special to her. If you’re pressed for time,**[we hope you’ll consider clicking here to make a contribution of $10 and help keep Lisa fighting for Delaware’s families.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53400908/375330908/-1113401298?refcode=EM_FR_221026LBRPersonalNote_FR_TEAM_90DO_7_NG_TESTBL1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzY2RlYzYyNC03ZTU1LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p3ddyaru83gDE71CGeH-Nt0B_OHGS8RTTEtMK5TYKeU=)**_ As we head into the final weeks of this race, I can’t help but reminisce on just how far we’ve come, and all that we’ve accomplished on the way to this moment.

Delaware will always be dear to me, not just because it’s my home, but because it’s the birthplace of my purpose and my commitment to service. From a young age, I had the privilege of going door-to-door with my dad, Ted Blunt, as he ran for City Council. On my neighbors' front steps, I witnessed the power of hard work and selflessness converge to create a strong community, and from then on, I vowed to do my part to maintain those values.

I began my career in service as a caseworker in Tom Carper’s Congressional office. It was here that I got a firsthand look at the issues that our communities faced daily, and where I stood on the frontlines to help. Whether it was problems with accessing Social Security benefits or housing needs, I saw it all and made it my personal mission to ease their burdens in any way I could. That commitment to people-driven service led to Delaware cabinet appointments under both Carper and his successor, Ruth Ann Minner.

If you'd like to unsubscribe | | In case you haven’t met me yet, Peter, let me introduce myself. I’m Chris Jones, and I’m running against Sarah Huckabee Sanders to be the next governor of Arkansas. I’m a seventh-generation Arkansan, minister, HBCU graduate, and former NASA physicist. My neighborhood is Arkansas, Peter — every last street and every single county. The best way to get to know someone is by walking a mile in their shoes, and that’s why I’ve visited Arkansans in every county across the state (twice, in fact!). I know the struggles Arkansans are facing, because I’ve walked 2,896,400 steps in their shoes. Our next governor needs to be prepared to move Arkansas into the future, not drag us back to the past. Arkansans are ready for new leadership that fights for their families in the governor’s office. I’d be so thankful to earn your support in my campaign to be the first Black governor of Arkansas, and I’m proud to work with The Collective PAC to build an America where Black people are equitably represented in the halls of power. | Grassroots donors make it possible for us to run a grassroots campaign and engage the untapped power of unreached voters who haven’t been fully included in our democracy. How? By meeting Arkansans where they’re at on Main Streets, front porches, and dirt roads across this great state of ours. In visiting all 75 Arkansas counties twice, I’ve learned that Arkansas isn’t the hopeless “red” state experts make it out to be — it’s a place where folks are eager for the opportunity to thrive under new leadership. Our state is filled with people of all backgrounds just looking to reach their highest potential, if only they could get just a little bit of help. But Peter, you wouldn’t get that impression from my opponent Sarah Huckabee Sanders. Her message of fear and division is just one example of how we’ve reached a level of toxicity in our politics, and Arkansas can’t stand it any longer — not if we’re serious about a new future for our state. It’s clear her brand of politics won’t help anyone but herself and her dark-money megadonors, and that’s a recipe for disaster. Our state deserves a governor willing to walk in the shoes of its people, and my family has known for over 200 years just what that’s like. I’m excited to help unlock the Promise of Arkansas for everyone, but we’ve still got some major work to do in these last 13 days before Election Day. According to U.S. News & World Report, Pennsylvania is ranked just 17th in K-12 education. Meanwhile, public schools throughout Pennsylvania are trying to fill learning gaps and address lower-than-average test scores that have resulted from closed schools during the COVID-19 pandemic. We’re also struggling with teacher retention and school safety.

Public education is on the ballot this November. We’ve prepared this newsletter so that you can get the information you need to make an informed vote. | **THE NEW GOVERNOR WILL DETERMINE THE FUTURE OF PUBLIC EDUCATION IN PENNSYLVANIA**

_Where do the candidates stand?_

This November, voters will choose between two competing visions for education in Pennsylvania: reducing public school budgets and using tax dollars to fund private schools, or investing to help our public schools recover and get our children back on track.
---
**JOSH SHAPIRO**

* Will fight to fully fund our public schools, especially in underserved areas with chronically underfunded schools. _1_
* Wants to increase funding for mental health programs in public schools. _2_
* Pledged to replace politicians with parents on the State Board of Education by appointing at least two parents to the Board. _3_
* Believes we must end the reliance on standardized testing so teachers can do their jobs. _4_
* Has been endorsed by Pennsylvania State Education Association and AFT Pennsylvania. _5_
* Would triple state funding for union skills programs and vocational training, helping people get good-paying union jobs and ensuring Pennsylvania’s manufacturing businesses get the skilled labor they need. _6_

| **DOUG MASTRIANO**

* Proposed slashing per-pupil spending by 52.6%, from $19,000 to $9,000, which is comparable to spending in states like Mississippi. _7_
* Has fought efforts to increase state education funding, placing a financial burden on local communities to raise property taxes to make up the difference. _8_
* Under Mastriano’s plan, schools in some districts would see revenue cut by as much as 67%. _9_
* Would slash education funding by more than $12 billion and eliminate more than 49% of jobs in public schools, resulting in drastic staff layoffs, considerable increases in class sizes, and lost student opportunities. _10_
* Voted for Senate Bill 1, which proposed giving a massive tax break to corporations and slashing public school budgets to fund private schools. _11_
