Meanwhile, public schools throughout Pennsylvania are trying to fill learning gaps and address lower-than-average test scores that have resulted from closed schools during the COVID-19 pandemic. We’re also struggling with teacher retention and school safety. Public education is on the ballot this November. We’ve prepared this newsletter so that you can get the information you need to make an informed vote. | THE NEW GOVERNOR WILL DETERMINE THE FUTURE OF PUBLIC EDUCATION IN PENNSYLVANIA Where do the candidates stand? This November, voters will choose between two competing visions for education in Pennsylvania: reducing public school budgets and using tax dollars to fund private schools, or investing to help our public schools recover and get our children back on track. JOSH SHAPIRO Will fight to fully fund our public schools, especially in underserved areas with chronically underfunded schools. 1 Wants to increase funding for mental health programs in public schools. 2 Pledged to replace politicians with parents on the State Board of Education by appointing at least two parents to the Board. 3 Believes we must end the reliance on standardized testing so teachers can do their jobs. 4 Has been endorsed by Pennsylvania State Education Association and AFT Pennsylvania. 5 Would triple state funding for union skills programs and vocational training, helping people get good-paying union jobs and ensuring Pennsylvania’s manufacturing businesses get the skilled labor they need. 6 | DOUG MASTRIANO Proposed slashing per-pupil spending by 52.6%, from $19,000 to $9,000, which is comparable to spending in states like Mississippi. 7 Has fought efforts to increase state education funding, placing a financial burden on local communities to raise property taxes to make up the difference. 8 Under Mastriano’s plan, schools in some districts would see revenue cut by as much as 67%. 9 Would slash education funding by more than $12 billion and eliminate more than 49% of jobs in public schools, resulting in drastic staff layoffs, considerable increases in class sizes, and lost student opportunities. 10 Voted for Senate Bill 1, which proposed giving a massive tax break to corporations and slashing public school budgets to fund private schools. 11 ---|--- CHECK THE FACTS: 1. 2\. 3\. 4\. 5\. psea.org, 12/21/2021; psea.org, 8/1/2022; pftvotes.org, accessed 9/29/2022. 6. 7\. 8\. Patriot Zach Rehl received an honorable discharge from the United States Marine Corps...and received a 100% disability rating from the Department of Veterans Affairs.

**But the FBI raided his home on March 17th, 2021, arrested him, and threw him in jail for peacefully protesting the stolen 2020 Presidential election at the Capitol on January 6th, 2021.
**
Zach didn't attack the U.S. Capitol Police. (His own father and grandfather were Philadelphia cops, like my brother, for Pete's sake.)

Zach didn't break anything, or even hurt anyone's feelings with harsh words.

**He simply exercised his right to free speech as an American citizen.
**
But because he's a member of the Proud Boys, Joe Biden's Department of Justice has charged him with seditious conspiracy.

Zach has been held without bail this entire time.

**What 's more, he hasn't had the chance to hold his baby girl even once.
**

**

You and I, and the people we love in are in grave danger.

**
That's why I ask to stand with me at this crucial time.

**I 'm Larry Klayman, the founder of Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.
**
I'm a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who's fought for the American people for 45 years.

You've seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows.

**I 'm proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.
**
I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama's corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama's illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents - AND WIN!
**
And now I'm pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden's rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I 'm doing in court to get justice for these poor people.
**
[Patriot, PLEASE help me double down in my fight to GET JUSTICE FOR ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS AND SET THEM FREE with your absolutely vital gift of $25, $50, $100 or even more RIGHT NOW.
](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=391c2f02d6a24c1c91e530387f841f47&_e=ehPSr0o3l9SMHy-CDvgpngiBuCOw0oVTlT7AFPOV1uK6NYLiKCv7YbfhxCI8RZFXBrmYdLF25WKKEvOMQAPvxfgE6ipt5Inx2uH48BOfugBtAzAJw_PTDELjVv2UnDQrBm7PnAXGCLCObm8HoDkh4sTZGSZBfnRK3SFxqXJtDYzOEYILShv9FKrhSnTk2vfvmOAN0Y9Z5baHSPfVhgRk-VqVnR6eeCvxQI0zSOJOkbQANtUtzShhNzHLBeEwX_Tfhf0h4HUjSHYRonaSnKuXAmFIcK3D2vQMxXvpSRw8z-q3udzC5iOJU4f31vIO1Dd6hkg7dfX7jLJyfr76zc9bvg%3D%3D)

Larry Klayman

name: Josh Harder
subject: we’re not taking a single day off
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Harder for Congress
body:
Peter,
A year ago, our district lines were finalized and I asked you to join me on this journey to win one of the most competitive districts in the entire country. We promised to do this the right way by talking about the issues that matter and not taking a single dime of corporate PAC money.
After a year of traveling the district and listening to voters, hiring our amazing team of organizers including a Latino Constituency Director, opening our campaign office and launching our TV ads, putting up yard signs (and replacing the vandalized ones), and responding to endless GOP attack ads... it has all come down to this.
**There are less than 12 days until November 8th, the final day of voting. Over these next 12 days tens of thousands of voters will make their decision and mail back their ballots. We have to treat every single day as Election Day.**
So, we're not taking a single day off, and I hope you'll stick with us. If you can, please make a donation [here](https://act.myngp.com/el/ANOBELJnBMX0akqjnh77YEjNb05Tu7XHzceRqW6nuUM=/fwsTmcADDt6RcNIqO4xeOQF52K23atF3o9W1yi4CH3s=?refcode=E19066-20221026-NoDaysOff-SL-CampaignFinance-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25) to help us win this toss-up race.
_Now let me explain the most recent developments in our race:_
First, we were on a high after I received the endorsement of The Modesto Bee, and scored a decisive win in the debate against my opponent last week.
But then, almost as soon as we could get the word out, Republicans launched a brand new wave of attacks calling me "a liar." The ad is everywhere - TV, mail, online. Everywhere voters look, they see negative smears against me.
And here's the problem... we're coming down to the wire and running out of budget to fight back. We need to raise $50,000 as quickly as possible to launch a new round of ads and support an influx of volunteers in the last weeks of this campaign.
That's why I'm asking you again for your support. Will you please use this link below to make an urgent donation of $25 for the last 12 days of this campaign?
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JHCA-09-Email-Oct2022-FR-October**](https://act.myngp.com/el/ANOBELJnBMX0akqjnh77YEjNb05Tu7XHzceRqW6nuUM=/fwsTmcADDt6RcNIqO4xeOQF52K23atF3o9W1yi4CH3s=?refcode=E19066-20221026-NoDaysOff-SL-CampaignFinance-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25)
I appreciate you for being a part of our grassroots movement and staying involved!
\- Josh

**[$100](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=d6f6e32c3e&e=3cd8121505)**
**God bless you, your families, and God bless America. The country we know, love, and must protect. ** **Your Friend in Christ,**

Leon Benjamin [****](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=8cadfce46d&e=3cd8121505)

subject: Do you have 30 minutes in the next 13 days?
body:
With 13 days until the election, we know it is more important than ever for folks to work to Get Out the Vote and make sure that we elect Democrats representing our voice and values. But did you know that YOU can make an impact by taking an hour out of your day to knock on doors, make calls, and text voters? Please check out below to find ways to get involved and do your part in electing Democrats up and down the ballot on November 8th!
Listen to Kerry!
Kerry Washington is teaming up with the Shade Room (https://www.instagram.com/p/CkGifpOLUKR/) and Democrats! You heard Kerry- too much is on the ballot to not vote this November. Visit IWillVote.com (https://iwillvote.com/) for information to make your plan to vote today, and share with 3 friends to make sure they get out and vote for Democrats!

More Ways to Get Involved

A wonderful way to get involved with the DNC is to join one of our phone banking events! See details below to find a phone banking time that works for you:

Join the DNC's Democratic Women Lead Virtual Phone Banks (https://events.democrats.org/event/528884/) on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 5pm – 7pm ET! Women were a driving force behind sending President Biden and Vice President Harris to the White House and electing the Democratic majorities they needed in the House and Senate. The stakes of these midterm elections could not be higher and it’s more important than ever that Democratic women continue to show up and lead! To sign up to make calls, please click here! (https://events.democrats.org/event/528884/)
Join this Thursday's Out & Proud Phone Bank (https://events.democrats.org/event/528877/) , with special guest Kelley Robinson, Incoming HRC President. The LGBTQ community is a critical voting bloc for the Democratic Party, and we need you to mobilize your friends and allies ahead of the coming election. To sign up, please click here! (https://events.democrats.org/event/528877/)

Join Team Unity for a virtual phone bank (https://events.democrats.org/event/533362/) and make calls into Georgia for this critical election. Sign up to join us on Monday, October 31 and Monday, November 7 at 6pm ET.

YOU are central to the organizing power of the Black community! We must elect Democrats like Stacey Abrams and Raphael Warnock and more that represent Our Values and Our Voice. Help them by talking to voters in Georgia! Sign up here (https://events.democrats.org/event/533362/) .

Sign up to Join Us For a #BlackWomenLead Weekend in Action North Carolina for Cheri Beasley with Higher Heights for America PAC!

Elect the leader North Carolina needs! We are less than two weeks out from Election Day and it's all hands-on deck to make history in North Carolina by helping us send Cheri Beasley to the U.S. Senate.

Join us virtually on Saturday, October 29th at 9am, 12pm, 3pm EDT (https://www.mobilize.us/higherheightspac/event/537231/) or in-person in Charlotte, NC on Saturday, October 29th from 10:45 – 12:30pm EDT (https://www.mobilize.us/higherheightspac/event/537232/) as we make calls and get out the vote for Cheri Beasley! For more details, please click here (https://linktr.ee/hhpac) .

Community Event Highlights

Wisconsin Dems

ICYMI: Gov. Evers on Nyob Zoo!

Earlier this month, Gov. Evers joined Nyob Zoo Milwaukee for an interview (https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/A7GQnnr_XzUYyessq5BiROLXbZGZWLkDUkgtNq4nm55lhrwVFcGpIzfvGG2PlWze1Ex6kuxOOwklnRYuj2NIb7VUTTFRROfpigS30nVrNVLrHqxdQMIu9eMuPMsL8heN4tpLCJRXUfgKCW2MHx2eQZ_RH21bDcnlJAaXH5rn76Ur10wCWKR67cIz8Kg8y3G6Fj5iLouusH_U4Ex3WpmY6ozYVUzZYuFJG0UxB7vgz9ZbIRMrbz4T5ZDNFQqTvDzRlvSjcEuqy2jQ_KTlfy7MHAI7zoWW84kZBsWOrbKgTv0/3qe/YMXcGkceQZult6kcnkkj6Q/h13/7ozoFiQHgJyZb_FPN8PQvYIeMD948MJCiBS-n4YdenU) about how he will continue to support our Hmong & Asian American communities with another term in office. Nyob Zoo Milwaukee is one of Wisconsin's premier Hmong-owned media companies. Its mission is to provide impactful news to enrich the lives of under-served Hmong Americans, Southeast Asian Americans, and Pacific Islanders, Wisconsin communities and beyond. Check it out here!
(https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/A7GQnnr_XzUYyessq5BiROLXbZGZWLkDUkgtNq4nm56sYv50kr99onUZqXflbPFysaJYZI6BZcedyVl0ymF3EX1oD1qxNJTxFGB3E0ve0wxtuPvdA_2A6DLQRS8wE48FiLeKne0b2UEEtuVB2j7o6TB3M5MZ3BSp1fPa3IBPjQeI7Y1QfUXgPMwkLpjo7uZ_g50yeLDKutN4rTqqwXZyyicIl-tdDWKcLi8Invkr4raSdhdCQLiCfiECVt8qqUW2C4yJwOXhIYCIW3Lc376IQ7XJviQxSk7iVe7J1oIYQSw/3qe/YMXcGkceQZult6kcnkkj6Q/h14/DRwz8mNXDl6UbZUyOhguIuHZa8La1Wl4A_jTkeqNrBE)

Rep. Ro Khanna (D-CA) joined the AAPI Caucus for a Meet & Greet at Cargo Coffee in Madison! He spoke with AAPI Caucus leaders about the importance of mobilizing our community to turn out for Gov. Evers and Mandela Barnes–and building the bench of more AAPI electeds!
LGBTQ+ Coalition and Dane County Community Organizing Team went knocking on doors in South Madison! We had dozens of conversations with voters about the importance of voting this November.

UPCOMING EVENT: AAPI Coalition Phone Bank w/ They See Blue PA,
South Asians for America, & More!

Join us on Sunday, October 30th from 3 – 5pm EDT for a virtual phone bank with volunteers from They See Blue PA, South Asians for America, and more! We will talk with Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders statewide about electing Pennsylvania Democrats up and down the ballot!

The most effective way for us to reach voters right now is through phone calls, and we need you to help us get the word out to make sure Democrats can have their voices heard.

This event will be virtual and can be joined here (https://events.democrats.org/event/488392/) .

Ohio Democrats

UPCOMING EVENTS: Ohio Workers First Campaign

** GOTV Door Knocking
------------------------------------------------------------

Join the Workers First Campaign on Saturday, October 29th — Sunday, October 30th (multiple times available) and knock on doors for Democrats up and down the ballot in Ohio. Talking to voters face to face is the best way to have an impact on this election!

Whether it's your first time canvassing, or if you’re an expert, you can join us to help our people-powered campaign. There will be training for approaching doors and using the MiniVan App at the event. The meeting location is795 National Rd, Wheeling, WV 26003. (https://www.mobilize.us/2022coordinatedcommittee/?country=US&state=WV) To sign up, please click here (https://www.mobilize.us/2022coordinatedcommittee/?country=US&state=WV) .

This Week: Initiative to Advance Equity and Opportunity for Latino Communities

The White House Initiative to advance equity and opportunity for Latino communities across the country began as a promise. Now the Biden-Harris Administration is keeping that promise. Their recent efforts for Latino families include expanding access to health care, lowering drug prices for seniors, providing student debt relief, creating well-paid jobs, and lowering Hispanic unemployment to its lowest rate in history.

Peter,

For nearly 15 years and throughout this Senate campaign, I've been forthcoming about the mental health challenges that I struggled with in the past. I have overcome a lot in my life – self-confidence issues, a stutter, and thanks to the help of mental health professionals, dissociative personality disorder.

I even wrote a book in 2008, called Breaking Free, about the trials I have faced in my life. On top of my efforts to be transparent with mental health issues, I regularly encourage those facing mental health challenges themselves – including our troops and veterans – to seek the help they need to overcome them.

But apparently my efforts to get treatment, make amends, and help others with similar struggles is not enough in the eyes of Raphael Warnock, who has run millions in false and misleading attack ads to tear me down.

name: Sen. Raphael Warnock (via Democrats.org)
subject: Derek, I'm once again counting on grassroots supporters like you to power this movement to victory:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic National Committee, **[www
body:
I need your support. Help protect Georgia’s Senate seat and elect Democrats up and down the ballot nationwide. | |
---
Derek, in January 2021, Democrats won the Georgia Senate runoff elections, securing a slim 50-50 Senate majority. Thanks to millions of grassroots folks like you, we removed Mitch McConnell as Majority Leader and got Washington working for the American people again. Now, not even two years later, a recent poll puts my reelection race at 46% - 46%. _Dead even._ With just 13 days until Election Day -- and with many Georgians casting their ballots right now -- I need your support. clean_body: I won’t ever stop speaking truth to power. | | | Hey Peter, Some folks tell me it's not "politically savvy" to speak on controversial topics, or to wade into the "culture war." They say I'm too blunt. 🙄 Too bad. I'm not going to sugarcoat or ignore racism, transphobia, or poverty. I won't ever stop speaking truth to power, no matter the consequences. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: I didn't run for office to make wealthy donors and political elites feel comfortable. 👎 I ran for the working people of TN-07. That's why our campaign is 100% grassroots-funded, so I'm accountable to the PEOPLE, not the wealthy and powerful. To gloss over the trauma that our communities face (or as my opponent Mark Green calls us, "those people") would be an insult and a betrayal. That's just not who I am. If that ruffles a few feathers, so be it. Thank you, good people! ✊ – Odessa | To give by check: Odessa for Congress 2817 West End Ave, Ste 126-401 Nashville, TN 37203

I was inspired by great women who broke barriers and defied expectations, women like Margaret Thatcher and Jeane Kirkpatrick.

That’s why I wrote this book. body:
| [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/30924?t=6&akid=5070%2E878179%2EjZBvbF) Friends,

Hey, it’s Adam Schiff. I’m reaching out to you personally [because I want you to join me in supporting Democrat Josh Riley and Voter Protection Project.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/30924?t=7&akid=5070%2E878179%2EjZBvbF) | [Split $7 between Josh Riley’s campaign and Voter Protection Project »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/30925?t=8&akid=5070%2E878179%2EjZBvbF)
---
If you have been following my work, then you know that I am deeply concerned about the future of our Democracy and our country. We cannot allow right-wing extremists to hijack our Democracy, and undermine the values and ideals that make us who we are as Americans. We just can’t.

**That’s why electing pro-Democracy, pro-Rule of Law candidates like Josh Riley to maintain our House Democratic Majority is so critical.**

Josh’s race in Upstate New York is among the most competitive in the entire country. The Hill has named it one of seven races that could determine control of the House, and the Cook Political Report is naming it a **TOSS ‐UP.**

[This is a monumental opportunity for Josh’s people-powered movement to prove its strength before the election. Can I count on you to split $7 between Josh’s campaign and Voter Protection Project today?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/30925?t=9&akid=5070%2E878179%2EjZBvbF)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Josh Riley and VPP will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/30926?t=10&akid=5070%2E878179%2EjZBvbF)

Thank you for stepping up at this critical moment,

Congressman Adam Schiff

The Voter Protection Project is on an important mission: To end partisan gerrymandering and voter suppression by electing candidates at the state and federal levels that are forceful advocates for voting rights. Our enfranchisement agenda includes working to ensure that every state has automatic voter registration and online voter registration, convenient early voting, and independent redistricting commissions to ensure politicians are not able to draw their own maps.

Please, consider making a [one-time contribution by clicking here](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/121?t=1&akid=5070%2E878179%2EjZBvbF). **Or, to make the most powerful lasting impact and help us oust Republicans up and down the ballot who attack our right to vote, make a[monthly sustaining contribution by clicking here](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/122?t=2&akid=5070%2E878179%2EjZBvbF).**

subject: Need a reason to donate to Giffords PAC today? Here’s five:
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Five days. Five reasons. Five dollars.
#

Friends -
In just 5 days, our October fundraising drive comes to a close, and [**we’re asking if you can contribute $5 to Giffords PAC to help us reach our monthly goal.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct22.6iboAv&refcode=em221026-1-15&t=1&akid=2665%2E3935704%2EtoVRtb)
Here are 5 reasons why your $5 contribution to Giffords PAC makes an impact:
1. In less than two weeks, we’re facing the most critical midterm elections of our lifetimes. Our president is ready and willing to sign significant gun legislation into law, and we need to make sure we wake up to a Congress on November 9th ready to make that happen.

2. Unfortunately, the United States has higher rates of gun violence than any other developed country in the world. It doesn’t have to be this way, and we are working every day at Giffords to advance solutions to end gun violence once and for all.

3. Over the summer, Congress passed the most significant gun safety legislation enacted in decades. Our work was a crucial step in making this happen, but there’s still more to be done. We need to keep our foot on the gas to help pass more legislation that will save lives, like universal background checks.

4. We’re currently running ads and sending mailers to voters in key states like Pennsylvania, Colorado, and Florida to help get out the vote for candidates up and down the ballot who will have the courage to act. Your donation goes directly toward fueling this critical work.

5. Most of our donations come from people like you chipping in small amounts of money to emails like these. Our collective power through this network of supporters is how we’re able to stand up to the gun lobby.

It's not an exaggeration when we say that your $5 has a direct impact on our work to save lives. That’s why we’re asking:
[**Will you chip in $5 or any amount you can to Giffords PAC today? We have just 5 days left until our October fundraising drive comes to a close, and we need your help to reach our pre-election fundraising goals.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct22.6iboAv&refcode=em221026-1-15&t=2&akid=2665%2E3935704%2EtoVRtb)

Thank you. Your support is crucial in the fight to end gun violence.
\- The team at Giffords

body:
let’s recap on what map manipulators across the country are doing to unjustly maintain power and suppress the power of people.
|
---

Hey team -- October has been busy. The fight for fair maps has gone to the U.S. Supreme Court. With your support, we are continuing this fight. And our affiliate -- the National Redistricting Foundation -- has played a pivotal role as well.

**But -- just in case you missed it, let’s recap what map manipulators across the country are doing to unjustly maintain power and suppress the power of the people.**
* * *
**[ALABAMA](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53420598/375369409/-703501776?refcode=20221026_AOTL_F_SCOTUSwrapup_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjlmOGQ4NmIwLTkyNTUtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGUwOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=NSHxJkqoVBeHX_Pf-sP4n46zIjDV0SvZz1pkmT_JOjQ=)**
The U.S. Supreme Court heard oral argument about Alabama's congressional map on October 4th. Alabama asked the Court to disregard decades of legal precedent and argued for the adoption of a new race-blind test under the Voting Rights Act. This would undermine the historic safeguards established to protect minority voters and designed to prevent against racially discriminatory maps -- just like the ones Alabama enacted.
* * *

body:
[ stdin# ]One Georgia Leadership Committee

Derek,

Tomorrow night, I hope you’ll join me and members of the cast of Abbott
Elementary, one of the best shows on television, for an important virtual
conversation about the state of education in Georgia.

Across the state, we are letting our children down by not fully supporting
public education and our educators. Educators are feeling the pressures of
growing workloads, insufficient support and inadequate compensation.

subject: Two years ago, Republicans confirmed Amy Coney Barrett and got one step closer to passing a national abortion ban.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
Remember how you felt that day two years ago? That’s what we need to channel into the next 13 days
#

Friends -
Two years ago today, Mitch McConnell and Senate Republicans rammed through Amy Coney Barrett’s nomination to the U.S. Supreme Court.
It was one of the final steps in the far-right’s plan to overturn Roe v. Wade and create a path to ban abortion nationwide. Amy Coney Barrett gave them the vote they needed to entirely overturn Roe.
That’s why abortion rights have been rolled back in dozens of states, and if we lose the Senate, extreme politicians like our opponent Ted Budd are prepared to pass a national abortion ban without exceptions.
Remember how you felt that day two years ago? That’s what we need to channel into the next 13 days to give this race everything we have.
[**Please make a donation right now to fight back against Republicans’ attacks and flip North Carolina. This is our best chance to secure the decisive vote in the U.S. Senate to end the filibuster and defend abortion rights.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221026-2-T1&t=1&akid=2129%2E357359%2EUaafD9)
This is what’s at stake and why we absolutely cannot let Mitch McConnell retake the majority. We’ve seen the damage that they do to our democracy and rights when they are in charge, and we know nothing will stand in their way from taking us even farther back — even if it required holding a Supreme Court seat open indefinitely.
It’s not about people, it’s about power.
So it’s our job to make sure they do not win. If there’s any chance of making progress and shaking up the corrupt status quo, then we cannot let them buy this seat for Ted Budd. We have to flip North Carolina. Together.
As a former Chief Justice, Cheri deeply understands what’s broken about our politicized, right-wing Supreme Court. She will not hesitate to cast the decisive vote to secure justice and defend our rights, but she needs us by her side now to win.
[**Make a donation right now to send Cheri Beasley to the U.S. Senate. We cannot afford a Republican majority that will target our rights and freedoms.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221026-2-T1&t=2&akid=2129%2E357359%2EUaafD9)

I’m running for governor because Arizonans deserve a leader who will put their needs first — and that’s exactly what I’ll do.

| Peter,

In just a moment, I’m going to ask if you can chip in to support my campaign for Arizona governor.

But first, I’d like to tell you a little bit more about why I’m running and why this race is so critical.

I was born and raised in Arizona, and I learned the value of service at a young age through my family and through church. I went on to a career as a social worker, advocating for women in crisis.

In that job, I met with countless Arizonans who felt like they didn’t have a voice, and that their government wasn’t looking out for them. It was clear we needed a change — but to change our government, we needed to change the people working within it. **So I ran for office — and I won.**

In the state legislature and as Arizona’s Secretary of State, I’ve fought hard to help Arizonans get ahead: expanding Medicaid, protecting the right to vote, and delivering a safe, secure election in 2020, even in the face of death threats and attacks from the far-right.

Peter, let me tell you about my far-right opponent. While I’m focused on delivering solutions as Arizona’s next governor, Kari Lake would rather sow division and chaos. She’s built her campaign around the Big Lie, embraces neo-Nazis, endorses anti-Semitic, anti-LGBTQ candidates, and spews dangerous conspiracy theories at every opportunity.

Quite simply, Kari Lake is dangerous to Arizonans. She supports criminalizing abortion. She wants to put government cameras in our children’s classrooms. She’s been a vocal supporter of anti-democratic efforts to make it harder for people to vote. As governor, Kari Lake would take us backward to a time with more restrictions and fewer personal liberties.

**There is so much on the line this fall. Arizonans deserve a leader who will defend our fundamental rights and get to work solving the problems we face. I am that leader. Kari Lake is not.**

I hope I can count on your support. And thank you for taking the time to read this message.

clean_body: I’m running for governor because Arizonans deserve a leader who will put their needs first — and that’s exactly what I’ll do. | Peter, In just a moment, I’m going to ask if you can chip in to support my campaign for Arizona governor. But first, I’d like to tell you a little bit more about why I’m running and why this race is so critical. I was born and raised in Arizona, and I learned the value of service at a young age through my family and through church. I went on to a career as a social worker, advocating for women in crisis. In that job, I met with countless Arizonans who felt like they didn’t have a voice, and that their government wasn’t looking out for them. It was clear we needed a change — but to change our government, we needed to change the people working within it. So I ran for office — and I won. In the state legislature and as Arizona’s Secretary of State, I’ve fought hard to help Arizonans get ahead: expanding Medicaid, protecting the right to vote, and delivering a safe, secure election in 2020, even in the face of death threats and attacks from the far-right. = | | | = | = | = | = | = Peter, let me tell you about my far-right opponent. While I’m focused on delivering solutions as Arizona’s next governor, Kari Lake would rather sow division and chaos. She’s built her campaign around the Big Lie, embraces neo-Nazis, endorses anti-Semitic, anti-LGBTQ candidates, and spews dangerous conspiracy theories at every opportunity. Quite simply, Kari Lake is dangerous to Arizonans. She supports criminalizing abortion. She wants to put government cameras in our children’s classrooms. She’s been a vocal supporter of anti-democratic efforts to make it harder for people to vote. As governor, Kari Lake would take us backward to a time with more restrictions and fewer personal liberties. There is so much on the line this fall. Arizonans deserve a leader who will defend our fundamental rights and get to work solving the problems we face. I am that leader. Kari Lake is not. I hope I can count on your support. body:
Dear Peter,
Good news, Bad news.
First, the good news:
My team just cut a great new ad making the choice between me and woke extremist Marie Perez very clear. You can watch the ad here: [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/choice](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/r2bDaUgUm6SvJzWwJJfROA/f9x4apcWZvrdK3VdxEJJVg).
Now, the bad news:
**We don 't have the money to get it on the air through Election Day. **
Can you please help us make sure the voters see this ad by donating at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/6k0eOLsUQGEWunykrORVDw/f9x4apcWZvrdK3VdxEJJVg)?
The differences between my opponent and me could not be greater.
She's a cheerleader for the inflation-causing, budget-busting omnibus spending that I will oppose.
She's called for higher taxes on energy while I will fight for energy independence.
She supports new gun control laws while I will defend the Second Amendment.
And she will keep Nancy Pelosi in power while I'll help Republicans take back the majority so we can begin to hold Biden accountable.
Help us keep this ad on the air with a donation at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/6k0eOLsUQGEWunykrORVDw/f9x4apcWZvrdK3VdxEJJVg).
Thank you and God Bless,

Joe Kent

body:
I can tell you that this was a terrible message. | |
---
Hi friend,

First off, I want you to vote. So take that as an official reminder! Second, I want to take a brief moment to talk about the Congressional Progressive Caucus and their release (and subsequent retraction) of a letter calling for "immediate negotiations to achieve peace in Ukraine." **[You can read a bit more here, if you missed the controversy.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDL0195r-gNaKL0NXw0E6jsbk1-zcAalI_e74NkotKxihbe2KW5L_2YgJGNIHzUyc1H7LzvkrqRieX1gf2u9bzycLMsQNK_kolKmFrE9e7IIiJsgi84QF8qY8VyZTyAnd1vzet9RJ7URI5zbb1ZJKVFj2HI0EeEKhVUB9jKfG2Xk1LHamuExnXW77ON5j1HseAYZ67yxUfIGvWoDJLkM3RscuGduqY9WAgxRrX0hCO8DqelGsy_NiBkTNI0Bqu8iaDl7a-svr-Enae-iDexu8mI9-d_UeAJWGtiOAir2tkLShFbEdLYOlHQUDI4mihyO9UkPBm2SDIqN3WmuTRqyCjkA/3qm/WkFzXcNKTBSC-J1FDWXaWQ/h0/9uHiaYVzJ6ocIFpRo7Qj-y7OTEH68ZdIm8tTpMZqPeo)** So, having been a diplomat, and then a defense analyst at RAND, I can tell you that this was a terrible message, with terrible timing, and I commend the Progressive Caucus for realizing that promptly and retracting it. I'm going to break down how I think about the letter (and the conflict), to give you some insight into how I think about these issues. **First, let's make clear the U.S. position:**

1. The United States desires peace in Ukraine, and it strongly opposes any escalation from Russia due to Russian failures in Ukraine.

2. The US decided to support Ukraine out of fear that Russian success in Ukraine would lead to further Russian aggression (just as giving Czechoslovakia to Nazi Germany made WW2 more likely, rather than less).

3. The Biden Administration has consistently messaged that our aid will continue until Russia withdraws (preferable) - or is defeated.

4. The GOP said last week that they would consider ceasing support for Ukraine if they win in November.

5. The CPC letter further undermines US credibility by throwing 30 members of the left in with the GOP -- implying that opposition to Ukraine aid is bipartisan.

**Second, let's think about Putin's position, and I say Putin because he is THE key Russian decision-maker. Russia as a whole may not want to be in Ukraine, but Russia is not a democracy.**

1. Putin thought this war would be quick and relatively painless.

2. The Russian Army failed a Blitzkrieg in February and the artillery-supported advance of early summer (an attack far more in line wit Soviet doctrine) has stalled - and now Russians are losing ground to Ukrainian counter-attacks.

3. Losing in Ukraine risks Putin's domestic political position

4. Escalating beyond Ukraine ALSO risks Putin's domestic political position (Would the military execute a suicidal nuclear strike on Western Europe? Would Russian political elites tolerate a tactical nuclear strike against Ukraine?)

5. If Putin thinks that US commitment to supplying Ukraine is weak, he will push fighting until at least the new Congress is seated, and will try to escalate in January (with a new Congress) to test US resolve.

6. Basically, the letter makes the US look weak, and Putin will try to hit Ukraine/pressure the US to see if he can "break" the US.

**Third, let's look at the Ukrainian position:**

1. They were not consulted on the letter!

2. Now they're not sure if they can depend on the US - either politically or in terms of further military assistance.

To summarize, it's a terrible letter and should never have been released. It will encourage Putin to keep fighting, it makes opposition to Ukraine assistance seem bipartisan (when it is mostly a GOP position), and it drives a wedge between us and the Ukrainians (and the Ukrainians are the good guys!). Putin will only stop fighting when it is clear he CANNOT win. This letter will give him hope.

Remember to vote! Max
Democrat and Combat Veteran for Congress

But first, tomorrow is my second debate with Don Bolduc, and I need every resource available to fight back against the attacks that Don Bolduc's dark money backers will launch the moment the debate ends. **That's why my team set a rapid response goal of $100,000.**

When my mother, who was born in 1931, married my dad, she lacked some of the most basic rights we take for granted today. States across the country had enormous restrictions on birth control – and often required a husband’s permission. When credit cards first came out, my mother couldn't get one in her own name. And she certainly wouldn’t have been guaranteed the freedom to end an unplanned pregnancy.

But that changed. Over the course of her lifetime – and mine – women have achieved their rights as full and equal citizens in our democracy.

This progress has made a difference – not just for women but for our communities, our businesses, and our country. **Inclusion brings out the best in everyone, and the inclusion of women has helped our country become the strongest, best democracy and economy in the world.**
But now, this progress is being stripped away. Without the protections of Roe v. Wade, anti-choice politicians, like my opponent, Don Bolduc, are attempting to make women second-class citizens.

If Don Bolduc had his way, our country would be a place where women's bodies are regulated; where Americans are robbed of their Social Security; where families continue to struggle to afford their medications while Big Pharma rakes in billions; and where the foundation of our democracy itself – our free and fair elections – is threatened.
**[This November, at stake is nothing less than a woman’s fundamental right to live as a free and equal citizen in our country.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53400792/375330614/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1936-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OGY3YTliOS03ZDU1LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=u-cf1zsvruJKjaVm-vs9caMEI8TycwvH4Ekbot3eC7c=)**
I am the third in a line of four women named Margaret. My grandmother, Margaret Cooke Byers, was born in 1898 and turned 22 on the day that Congress passed the 19th Amendment, allowing women to vote. My mother, Peggy Byers Wood, saw women achieve the right to control their own bodies, finances, and futures with the Roe decision. I am the third Margaret, becoming the second woman in the history of America to be elected both Governor and Senator.

I'm sending you this email because if Don Bolduc's vision for America goes forward, my daughter, the fourth Margaret, will have fewer rights than I did at her age. That's unacceptable.

I need your support now more than ever. If we lose this seat, we will lose our Democratic Senate majority and any chance we have at moving this country forward. **[Please rush $3 or any amount you can to continue the progress we've been working on for hundreds of years.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53400793/375330615/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1936-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OGY3YTliOS03ZDU1LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=u-cf1zsvruJKjaVm-vs9caMEI8TycwvH4Ekbot3eC7c=)**

clean_body: This November, at stake is nothing less than a woman’s fundamental right to live as a free and equal citizen in our country. | | | Hi there – I want to tell you a little bit about me and the women who shaped me. But first, tomorrow is my second debate with Don Bolduc, and I need every resource available to fight back against the attacks that Don Bolduc's dark money backers will launch the moment the debate ends. That's why my team set a rapid response goal of $100,000. So before I go any further, I have to ask: = | | = When my mother, who was born in 1931, married my dad, she lacked some of the most basic rights we take for granted today. States across the country had enormous restrictions on birth control – and often required a husband’s permission. When credit cards first came out, my mother couldn't get one in her own name. And she certainly wouldn’t have been guaranteed the freedom to end an unplanned pregnancy. But that changed. Over the course of her lifetime – and mine – women have achieved their rights as full and equal citizens in our democracy. This progress has made a difference – not just for women but for our communities, our businesses, and our country. Inclusion brings out the best in everyone, and the inclusion of women has helped our country become the strongest, best democracy and economy in the world. But now, this progress is being stripped away. Without the protections of Roe v. Wade, anti-choice politicians, like my opponent, Don Bolduc, are attempting to make women second-class citizens. If Don Bolduc had his way, our country would be a place where women's bodies are regulated; where Americans are robbed of their Social Security; where families continue to struggle to afford their medications while Big Pharma rakes in billions; and where the foundation of our democracy itself – our free and fair elections – is threatened. = I am the third in a line of four women named Margaret. My grandmother, Margaret Cooke Byers, was born in 1898 and turned 22 on the day that Congress passed the 19th Amendment, allowing women to vote. My mother, Peggy Byers Wood, saw women achieve the right to control their own bodies, finances, and futures with the Roe decision. I am the third Margaret, becoming the second woman in the history of America to be elected both Governor and Senator. I'm sending you this email because if Don Bolduc's vision for America goes forward, my daughter, the fourth Margaret, will have fewer rights than I did at her age. That's unacceptable. | | | | | Peter, My path to running for U.S. Senate was different than most. I don't come from a wealthy family. I didn't enter this race with a bunch of mega-donors lining up to write big checks to this campaign. My mom was a public school teacher and my dad worked third shift at General Motors. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class. Ever since I was a little kid, my parents taught me never to settle for what is, but to reach for what can be. It was how I graduated high school at the age of 16 and went on to be elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly when I was 25. And it's how I won Wisconsin’s Lieutenant Governor race in 2018 and helped beat Scott Walker. Then, after careful thought and consideration, I decided to get in this U.S. Senate race to defeat Ron Johnson. It was a big decision. I knew that this was going to be one of the most competitive races in the entire country. And it is a race that we must win if we're going to defend and expand the Democratic Senate majority. I was willing to bet that if I decided to run, people like you would come together in large numbers to help fund this campaign. Because the truth is that no single person can flip Wisconsin's Senate seat alone. It will only happen if we're in this together. **[With $31 million in attack ads against me so far, I urgently need your support in order to have the resources to take on the right-wing super PACs and win in November.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdc5094c9-275c-482b-b12a-28e797f63ac1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** So I’m asking:

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Please donate before our final deadlines ahead of Election Day
body:
We need an absolutely HUGE day today to stay on track to hit our goals. | | |
---
| | Friends – I’m writing to ask if there’s ANYTHING I can say to convince you to split a contribution between my campaign and the DLCC before our final fundraising deadlines ahead of Election Day. What if I told you that my opponent is a “hardcore-MAGA” extremist who backed a national abortion ban? What if I told you that Donald Trump’s Super PAC “MAGA, Inc” started airing $1 MILLION in TV ads attacking me just days before voters begin casting their ballots – and those ads could have effects down-ballot, too? What if I told you this race is already one of the most expensive races of the 2022 election — and the cost will only get higher in these final few weeks before Election Day? body:
I hope you’ll be watching.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1132%2E61531%2EaRG6Ny)
Hi friends—
In just a few moments, I’ll be heading out for the next debate in this Senate race, but first, I wanted to speak directly with you and this grassroots movement.
I hope you’ll be watching, because this is one of our last major opportunities to make our case for our progressive priorities. Tonight, I want to make it clear once more that we can continue to deliver results for the people of Vermont and working families nationwide. But we’ll need a Senator who embodies and fights for our shared values and a Senate that makes things happen — not the Mitch McConnell-controlled Senate that has repeatedly chosen the interests of wealthy corporations over the people.
This campaign isn’t about me, it’s about all of us and our future. And with so much on the line — from abortion rights to climate change to the rising costs impacting working families — I’ll feel much better knowing you’re right there with me.
Election Day is right around the corner, and voters are making up their minds and already casting ballots. Tonight’s performance on and off the stage could be what propels us to victory. [**If you’re with me in this fight, it would mean a lot if you could chip in $3 or any amount to show your support.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4741?t=3&akid=1132%2E61531%2EaRG6Ny)

Peter, It’s now clearer than ever — Charlie Crist is dangerous for Florida.

His allegiance to the far-Left’s extreme agenda puts Floridians at risk of facing the same fate as other failed blue states around the country.

On every topic, Charlie Crist takes the most extreme stance — right in line with the Democrat Machine. **[STOP THE BIDEN-CRIST AGENDA](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b66c1a74c9304ec4b32a4d0c1d6bba41&_e=Bxka-yJNKcSR31KDYN3ESFZVgGtjXGTXgqGd0_q6HoSu8XBl5p92xK9IbClM5UvaWGgVi0AbLWMBTsGVP6NEonGjeplmpjorIj3CUgSaD2AB_DM5mVeQ6XsxMDVt2plHxv0I1IrOGEL7MP_bjOS4GPdKb1gPXfP2rhkWhl41jQDC_Hmi6MkTWklzNRjuFPPOAtb5ehIRXEADma4EI8btKPK8UmaXUq4vvWB4vV_mTUhqtOLwzNbqJqPqYfqTVZMia_XkEnJbsXPKr37btkUV0dGIL050u2Oo0oadVCNpzUYU-dpY_XfRcj7xU08J4Zxumz_Q1HW0kBJlc_J0xCYa-td51KD0PspP-PwAL2NqrxI%3D)** __
---
| | Over the course of the debate, Charlie cemented for Floridians that:
* He votes 100% of the time with Joe Biden, and like the rest of the Democrats, he wants the government to control your kids. If it were up to Charlie, Florida schools would subject students to forced COVID jabs and indoctrination with woke ideologies.
* If it were up to Charlie, Florida would be a sanctuary state. He cares more about advancing Biden’s open border agenda than keeping Floridians safe.
* Charlie’s jailbreak agenda is in lockstep with the radical pro-crime views of Soros-affiliated prosecutors who are allowing criminals to wreak havoc in cities across our nation. His rejection of law and order would put Floridians in danger.
* Charlie spent the last two years serving as a rubber stamp for the Biden Regime and wants nothing more than to bring the Biden Regime’s destructive policies to Florida.

What's more, Peter, _**Charlie only showed up to work 14 days this year**_ , because he isn’t interested in performing the duties of the many offices he has run for in his political career spanning five decades.

_**Not surprising coming from Biden’s biggest cheerleader.**_

Throughout the debate, Charlie dutifully played his role as a political puppet for the Biden Regime.

Since day one, Charlie has praised Biden’s failed policies and declared at every opportunity that he considers Joe Biden the “greatest president of our lifetime” — yes, the same Biden who has been plunging our country into a downward spiral since he took office.

Charlie made clear that he will take his orders from a puppet who can hardly read from a teleprompter.

_**Truth be told, Peter, I’m wary of anyone who matches Biden’s agenda, rhetoric, and confused, empty gaze. I think I can speak for most Floridians when I say they don’t want another Joe Biden infiltrating our state.**_ [**STOP THE BIDEN-CRIST AGENDA**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b66c1a74c9304ec4b32a4d0c1d6bba41&_e=Bxka-yJNKcSR31KDYN3ESFZVgGtjXGTXgqGd0_q6HoSu8XBl5p92xK9IbClM5UvaWGgVi0AbLWMBTsGVP6NEonGjeplmpjorIj3CUgSaD2AB_DM5mVeQ6XsxMDVt2plHxv0I1IrOGEL7MP_bjOS4GPdKb1gPXfP2rhkWhl41jQDC_Hmi6MkTWklzNRjuFPPO8roREEqvn_f59RHG9HquKAEyZiKRMr4ZFxE0NwFVeAsVofWLROHY7Vhq6bPRAjXw7AHpUVfq5p91MwxDH5KSA6qj_ZFIf_5UMwMxn70WwgOraOn5hB2JkRREINNckyz-Ow2mkK2DewBKF5hmiiugYsUBIRnbeRW6ncy3EZS_qYM%3D) My opponent talked a lot about decency, Peter, I’m not really sure what’s decent about locking people in their homes, destroying their businesses, and keeping children out of school.

Aside from comparing himself to Tom Brady and Jesus Christ, I can’t think of anything more ridiculous than Charlie Crist asking Floridians to trust him.

In the end, Charlie lost the fight to shut down schools, lost the fight to shut down businesses, lost the fight to lock people in their homes, and now, we need to come together as Floridians to deliver his destructive policies a loss once and for all.

_**[Stand with me to Keep Florida Free! name: Gabby Giffords
subject: I never lost hope
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
We need a big fundraising day today!
#

Friends,
I’ve known the darkest of days. But confronted by despair, I summoned hope.
I have always loved connecting with people. Meeting them, singing with them, laughing with them. And then suddenly, I could not speak. My life changed forever.
It would have been easy to give up. But I was lucky. I had Mark by my side.
In the early days of my recovery, Mark wasn’t just my husband. He was my champion. My rock. And with him and a community of family, friends, nurses, doctors, and specialists, I kept moving forward. It took time and determination, but I found my voice again.
That is what Mark does. He brings people together, and he won’t ever give up on you. There will always be dark days, but with Mark I have hope. With Mark by my side I know I can make it through.
I know how special it is to have someone like Mark in your corner. I know how special it is to have so many supporters from all over the country in your corner, too. And I know how important it is to ask for help if you need it.
With the election just days away, Mark needs you.

| | Friend,

Today is Congressman Troy Carter's 59th birthday!

[**_Help him celebrate with a $59 contribution to his re-election campaign._**](https://congressmantroycarter.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47f144cfbca3f0c81de469f60&id=35216d8a9c&e=dd5c2df611)

In Rep. Carter's year and half of representing Louisiana's 2nd congressional district he helped secure an over **$7.2 billion investment in roads, bridges, coastal protection, internet, ports, and more**.

Rep. Carter wrote and worked on many impactful bills, like the **Revitalizing Small and Local Businesses Act** and the **Protecting Our Kids Act** , which prohibits the sale of semi-automatic firearms to people under 21 years old, regulates ghost guns, establishes new gun trafficking laws, and more.

**After Hurricane Ida, he fought to bring national attention to the devastation in our region and secured recovery funding** for hard-hit communities like Jefferson Parish and fought for the **American Rescue Plan** ’s framework to bring our economy back from COVID-19 equitably.

In addition, he supported efforts to invest $555 billion in climate, clean energy jobs, and environmental justice; voted in favor of legislation to codify reproductive rights; cosponsored legislation to prevent federal funding from going to “conversion” therapy; and fought to ensure communities like Gretna were not hurt by poorly planned infrastructure projects.

[_**Can you chip in to keep Rep. Carter doing impactful work for Louisiana in congress?**_](https://congressmantroycarter.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47f144cfbca3f0c81de469f60&id=587de1a587&e=dd5c2df611)

Early voting is now open across our great state, affording voters the opportunity to vote in person prior to Election Day. Early voting is open now through Nov. 1st, from 8:30 am to 6 pm. Make a plan to vote to re-elect Congressman Troy Carter!

[_**Donate $59 to help Rep. Carter celebrate his 59th birthday!**_](https://congressmantroycarter.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47f144cfbca3f0c81de469f60&id=7a12cab3ae&e=dd5c2df611)

Funds Drag Shows in Latin America ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60793&L=28356&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvc3RhdGUtZGVwdC1mdW5kcy1kcmFnLXNob3dzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNvcnJ1cHRpb24rY2hyb25pY2xlcyZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==) Judicial Watch In yet another questionable venture by the State Department to achieve foreign policy goals through art, the agency is giving a Latin American country nearly $21,000 to produce drag shows. The goal, according to the government’s grant announcement, is to promote diversity and inclusion by funding three workshops, 12 drag theater performances and a two-minute documentary. The project is part of the State Department’s foreign diplomacy programs, which aim to advance national interests and enhance national security by informing and influencing foreign publics, according to the grant document. body:
Early voting is underway, and Election Day is less than 2 weeks away. Nancy Mace needs your help! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/d1c1d45e786f/are-you-voting-this-november?e=ddc57b5ede)
---
| |
---
| |
# Team Mace Campaign Update
Friends, we are in the last two weeks of this critical campaign.

On Election Day 2020 a gallon of regular unleaded was $1.83, and today at the same station it's $3.37. That's an 84% increase in the price of oil since the markets realized Joe Biden was going to be in charge!

We can't afford two more years of this.

This election is about Joe Biden's failed record on inflation, gas prices and his lawless open borders policies that are pouring deadly fentanyl right here into our district.

_But make no mistake_ : this district is the 10th fastest growing in the nation, and while momentum is on our side, if we don't turn out the vote, we could lose this seat in November.

## Watch Our Latest Ad
[](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=274801cd6d&e=ddc57b5ede)
[Watch on YouTube](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=d3a5927dbb&e=ddc57b5ede)
##
State of the Race

We are cautiously optimistic that, despite the challenges of this ever-changing district, we will win on Election Day -- if we turn out the vote!

The political winds have shifted nationwide, both the House and the Senate look like they're in play and the economy and inflation continue to be the main driver of independent and swing voters.

We won our debate last week, and now it's on to getting our voters to turn out both with early voting and on Election Day!
##
Early Voting is Live!

Early voting is currently underway across the state through November 5.

If you need more information on early voting or need to find where you can vote early, [visit our website here.](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=65e256610b&e=ddc57b5ede)

## Join #TeamMace Today!
If you want actively work to end Nancy Pelosi's career and put a check against Joe Biden's reckless spending, we want you to join #Team Mace.

We can't do this without your help! We're building a team of all-star volunteers to help us:
* Be social media ambassadors
* Knock doors
* Make phone calls
* Request yard signs
* Deliver yard signs
* Attend events

If you would like to join our team, [click this link here](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=f26d584632&e=ddc57b5ede) to sign up, and someone will be in touch with you shortly.

Thank you so much again for all your help, and together we will deliver on Election Day Tuesady, November 8.

Signed,
Team Nancy Mace for Congress
